26007355.title: HAEMONGGA
26007355.official_plot: 1776년, 영조 52년의 조선. 저잣거리에서 푼돈을 받고 꿈을 해석해 주던 유명한 해몽가이자 침술가 '유견' 앞에 왕세손 '이산'이 찾아와 불면의 밤에서 벗어날 수 있게 도와 달라 청한다. 이산이 약속한 큰 보상에 혹해 궁으로 들어간 유견은 그의 어의가 되어 그의 일상을 바로잡고 불면을 치료하려 애쓰지만, 이산은 끊임없는 정치적 압박과 암살 위협에 시달리며 점점 무너져 간다. 용포조차 제대로 입지 못하는 의대증과 아버지 '사도'의 죽음에서 벗어나지 못해 광증 증상까지 보이며 치료에 난항을 겪는 이산은 왕세손으로서의 자리마저 위태로워진다. 유견은 그를 괴롭히는 악몽을 해석해 모든 광증의 근원을 해결하려고 하지만 그 끝에서 마주한 것은 또 다른 악몽 같은 진실이었으니... 잠 못 이루던 밤, 이제 모든 것이 밝혀진다.
checklist: 年代=1776年(英祖52年)的朝鮮,不是別的年代
유견 Yugyeon:在市井收小錢解夢的解夢家【兼針灸師】,兩個身分都要在
이산 Yi San:王世孫(後來的正祖),因創傷而失眠、做惡夢
유견是被【重賞】吸引才入宮,入宮後職位是【御醫】
이산的兩個症狀:衣帶症(連龍袍都穿不上)+ 狂症,根源是父親【思悼世子】之死
이산同時受政治壓迫與暗殺威脅,王世孫之位也不保
結局:유견解夢想根治狂症,最後撞見的卻是【另一個如惡夢般的真相】——官方刻意不揭曉那是什麼
類型是【팩션 사극(faction 史劇)】—— 有真實歷史人物但情節是虛構,不可寫成史實
外部多源補充:이산 的創傷是【親眼目睹父親之死】,官方頁只寫『無法擺脫父親之死』
이산 的恐懼包含【自己正在變得像思悼世子】(觀眾席與劇評共同指出),不是單純的瘋病
2025 先做 트라이아웃、2026-06-25~09-13 才是 본공연(예스24스테이지 1관)
26007355.note: 官方 줄거리 只到『另一個惡夢般的真相』就停住,【沒有】說明真相內容。若 Perplexity 三語都寫出同一個具體真相,依 SOP §3.1 規則 1 那是同源痕跡不是佐證,要當作未證實處理。另:漢字劇名【解夢家】即出自這一檔的官方海報書法(已上線)。 【外部查證等級】官方+namu+4 家媒體+2 篇觀後感+1 討論串 = 9 源,多來源交叉,劇情主幹完全一致。
26007355.en:
Yugyeon earns small coins in the Hanyang market by reading strangers' dreams and treating their ailments with acupuncture, until a desperate visitor interrupts his ordinary trade. The visitor is Yi San, the Crown Prince, who has not slept peacefully for years. Tormented every night by the same nightmare, he offers Yugyeon a lavish reward if the dream interpreter can free him from the darkness that closes in whenever he tries to rest.

Lured by the promised payment, Yugyeon enters the palace and becomes Yi San's physician. He attempts to impose order on the prince's disordered days, observing his habits, treating his body, and pressing him to recount the visions he has tried to suppress. Yet Yi San's sleeplessness cannot be explained as a simple illness. Political enemies watch for signs of weakness, threats of assassination surround him, and the pressure of his position leaves him increasingly unstable. Even the royal robe becomes unbearable to wear, while hallucinations and fits of madness make his claim to the throne appear dangerously fragile.

At the center of Yi San's terror stands Sado, his father, whose death Yi San witnessed and whose fate continues to invade the prince's dreams. Yugyeon tries to interpret each recurring image and trace the illness back to its source, believing that naming the nightmare may rob it of its power. But as their sessions draw Yi San further into memories he cannot control, the boundary between dream and waking life begins to dissolve. A concealed truth emerges from beneath the nightmares, bringing danger to both men and changing the uneasy bond between healer and patient. Yi San must confront what he has feared to remember if he is to survive the night and retain his place in the palace.
The musical centers on trauma, grief, insomnia, and the psychological violence of political power. It asks whether painful memories can be escaped, or whether recovery requires facing them directly and choosing to live beyond them.
26007355.zh:
1776年朝鮮，市井中替人解夢、施針的解夢家柳堅，迎來了隱匿身分前來求助的王世孫李祘。李祘受父親思悼世子慘死的陰影糾纏，夜夜墜入同一場惡夢，長年失眠，更在朝堂鬥爭與接連不斷的暗殺威脅下瀕臨崩潰。他以優渥報酬為條件，要柳堅帶他逃離無眠的黑夜。

柳堅隨李祘入宮，成為侍候王世孫的醫者。他從作息、針灸與夢境著手，試圖讓李祘重拾安眠；然而，李祘連龍袍也難以穿上，精神愈發恍惚，彷彿在現實與夢魘之間失去了界線。柳堅逐步解讀那些反覆出現的意象，發現困住李祘的並非單純病症，而是父親之死留下的創傷、對權力鬥爭的恐懼，以及不敢正視的內心真相。隨著祕密被揭開，兩人原本的醫病關係也遭逢危機。

在一個又一個無法醒來的夜晚裡，李祘必須決定是否直視最深的恐懼，柳堅也得面對解開夢境後所帶來的代價。當惡夢終於被說破，逃離或許不再是唯一的答案，而是學會背負傷痛，走向清醒與未來。
26007355.cn:
1776年，汉阳街头的解梦师兼针灸师柳坚靠替人释梦谋生，忽然被饱受失眠折磨的王世孙李祘找上门。李祘自目睹父亲惨死后，夜夜被相同的噩梦、幻觉与惊惧吞没；宫廷中的权力倾轧和接连不断的威胁，更令他无法安睡。为摆脱这无尽长夜，他许下重酬，请柳坚随自己入宫。

柳坚本想借此改变困顿生活，却很快发现，李祘的病并非几根银针或几句吉兆可以化解。他从饮食起居、梦中意象到李祘避而不谈的旧事逐一探查，试图替这位年轻的继承人梳理混乱的心绪。随着治疗推进，梦境与现实的界线日益模糊：反复出现的恐怖景象并不只是幻梦，而是将被压抑的记忆、罪责、恐惧与宫闱秘辛不断推向眼前。

当真相逐渐显露，柳坚与李祘也被卷入新的危机。一个以解梦为生、习惯旁观他人命运的人，必须决定是否承担介入王室秘密的代价；而李祘则不得不直面父亲之死留下的创伤，以及自己始终逃避的内心。

两人从彼此试探到相互依靠，在噩梦深处寻找苏醒的可能。真正需要被解开的，不是一场梦的吉凶，而是人如何承认伤痛、穿越恐惧，并重新选择活下去。

26006404.title: Black Mary Poppins
26006404.official_plot: 아무도 이 사실을 몰라야 한단다... 1926년 독일의 저명한 심리학자인 그라첸 슈워츠 박사 대저택 화재 사건. 화재로 인해 대저택은 물론 시체마저 훼손되어 흔적도 남지 않고, 이 사건은 세간에 널리 알려지며 강렬한 인상으로 각인된다. 박사의 연구 조교이자 입양된 네 아이들의 보모였던 메리 슈미트는 아이들을 극적으로 구출한 뒤, 전신화상을 입은 채 사라진다. 사건 다음날, 병원에서 사라진 메리의 행방은 찾지 못하고 아이들은 화재 당시 있었던 일에 대해 아무것도 기억하지 못한다. 그렇게 사건은 미제로 남는다. 12년이 흐른 뒤, 네 명의 아이들은 각기 다른 집에 입양돼 새로운 삶을 살아가고 사건은 사람들의 기억 속에서 서서히 잊혀진다. 그러나 그라첸 박사의 비밀수첩이 한스에게 건네지고, 멈춰 있던 사건이 다시 움직이기 시작하는데...
checklist: 地點是【德國】、年份【1926】,火災發生在心理學家【그라첸 슈워츠(Grazen Schwartz)博士】的大宅
四個孩子的名字與身分:한스 시몬(長,律師,酒精成癮)/헤르만 디히터(次,畫家)/안나 레아(三,唯一女性,音樂教師)/요나스 엥겔스(么,恐慌症+語言障礙)
保母【메리 슈미트 Mary Schmidt】:博士的研究助理兼四個【被收養】孩子的保母,救出孩子後全身燒傷失蹤
隔天她從醫院消失,孩子們對火災當時完全失憶 → 案件成為【미제(懸案)】
【12 年後】四人被【各自不同的家庭】收養,案件被淡忘
重啟契機:그라첸 박사的【비밀수첩(祕密手記)】被交到【한스】手上 —— 不是別人、不是別的東西
官方 SYNOPSIS 用『화재 사건』,人物介紹用『방화사건(縱火)』—— 縱火這個定性只出現在人物欄
官方到『事件重新開始轉動』就停,【沒有】揭露真相是什麼
🚨【2026 這一輪是 All-round 버전】(namu 註30『최초로 All-round 버전으로 돌아왔다』)——歷屆是單一視角:재연=한스 ver《메리 포핀스 살인 사건을 위한 변호》/ 사연=헤르만 ver《모래 사나이가 나오는 꿈》/ 오연=요나스 ver《숲의 기억》/ 칠연=안나 ver《안나의 방 - 두 개의 책상》。寫簡介要對【本輪】,不可只寫某一人視角
🚨 四人是【의남매(收養而成的兄妹)】不是親兄妹 —— 他們是博士【各自收養】的四個孩子
🚨 重大情節:四個孩子其實是博士的【실험 대상(實驗對象)】(namu 註8)—— 官方 Interpark 頁完全沒寫
요나스的工作是出版社的【오탈자 교정(校對錯字)】,兒時夢想是【作家】
헤르만是『기괴한 작품들로 평단의 조롱과 대중의 열광을 동시에 받는』藝術家(後來成為畫家)
안나【只以名字被稱呼,全劇沒提過姓】;穿遮住全身、扣到領口的長洋裝
메리 슈미트是火災的【유력한 용의자】,在醫院治療中【逃走】,不是單純失蹤
劇作/作曲/導演都是【서윤미】一人;2012 初演;2014 與日本【東寶】簽授權,7/5 東京世田谷公共劇場日本初演
⚠ 官方 2026 頁說祕密手記交到【한스】手上;namu(較舊版本)說交給【四個孩子】—— 以本輪官方為準
26006404.note: 簡體《水曜日》是中國另做的改編版名字,不是這齣的中文名(v2.111.1 已撤)。要注意 Perplexity 可能把中國版《水曜日》的設定寫進來。人物名是德文音譯,三語都不可自創英文/中文名。 【外部查證】官方+namu+중앙일보+더뮤지컬+시어터플러스+디지스트신문+2 篇觀後感+官方 STORY FILM = 9 源。最大收穫是 namu 揭露的兩件官方頁沒寫的事:四人是【收養的義兄妹】、而且是博士的【實驗對象】;以及 2026 這輪是【全視角版】。
26006404.en:
Hans brings his estranged siblings back together after receiving a notebook connected to the fire that destroyed Dr. Gretzen Schwartz’s mansion twelve years earlier. In 1926, the renowned psychologist had taken in four orphaned children—Hans, Hermann, Anna, and Jonas—who lived under the care of Mary Schmidt, his research assistant and their nanny. When the mansion burned, Dr. Gretzen died and the children survived, rescued by Mary, who was left severely burned. Hailed at first as their saviour, Mary vanished after arson suspicions turned toward her; the traumatised children, unable to remember the night, were separated and adopted into different homes.

Now adults, they return with scars that time has not erased. Hans has become a lawyer but cannot free himself from the past; Hermann channels his instability into painting; Anna has become a teacher whose composure conceals an old terror; and Jonas, working at a publishing house, remains haunted by panic and fractured speech. As they compare memories prompted by the notebook, their recollections clash, overlap, and gradually expose what life in the mansion had concealed. Dr. Gretzen’s experiments had used the children as subjects, repeatedly erasing their memories, particularly after Wednesday sessions that left them unable to account for lost time.

The siblings finally recall the day Anna was chosen for another experiment and the others witnessed her suffering. Jonas, overwhelmed by rage, pushed Dr. Gretzen, causing his death. Hermann then took responsibility for the body and set the fire, while all four children became bound to the act and its aftermath. Mary did not betray them: at their desperate request, she used hypnosis to bury the truth and protect them. Reclaiming those memories twelve years later, Hans, Hermann, Anna, and Jonas must decide whether to seek oblivion again or endure the pain together.

The musical confronts childhood abuse, trauma, guilt, and the unreliable nature of memory. Its central act of healing is not forgetting: it is choosing to acknowledge unbearable truth, mourn what was lost, and continue living with one another.
26006404.zh:
1926年，德國知名心理學家葛雷森・舒瓦茲博士的宅邸陷入火海；在焦黑殘骸中，保母兼研究助理瑪麗・施密特救出被博士收養的漢斯、赫爾曼、安娜與約納斯，自己卻全身重傷。隔日，瑪麗從醫院不告而別，四個孩子也失去火災當晚的記憶，宅邸內的死者與真相一同被烈焰吞沒，案件遂成懸案。

十二年後，長大的四兄妹各自被不同家庭收養，帶著難以言明的創傷生活。直到長兄漢斯收到博士留下的祕密筆記本，沉寂多年的往事再度被喚醒，他召集兄妹尋找失蹤的瑪麗。隨著片段記憶逐一拼合，他們察覺博士曾在孩子們身上進行殘酷實驗，而那場大火並非單純意外。

每個人記得的夜晚都不同：有人記得恐懼，有人記得罪惡感，也有人寧可相信瑪麗是毀滅一切的兇手。四人循著筆記、童年故事與反覆浮現的幻象回到真相核心，終於明白瑪麗當年消失的原因，以及自己在火災裡各自做出的選擇。

當被抹去的記憶重新復甦，兄妹不得不共同承擔曾經逃避的傷痛。他們不再求助於遺忘，而是選擇直視悲劇、悼念失去的人，帶著不幸走向可能幸福的未來。
26006404.cn:
1926年，德国心理学家格拉岑·施瓦茨博士的宅邸被烈火吞没，保姆兼研究助理玛丽·施密特浑身烧伤，却从火场救出汉斯、赫尔曼、安娜和约纳斯四个被博士收养的孩子。博士葬身火海，宅邸与尸体皆被焚得难辨原貌；被赞为“天使”的玛丽却在次日从医院离奇失踪，四个孩子也完全失去了火灾当夜的记忆。

十二年后，四兄妹早已被不同家庭收养，过着互不相同的人生。一册寄来的秘密笔记本打破平静，将他们重新召集起来。笔记中留下的零碎记录、彼此矛盾的回忆，以及反复浮现的“星期三”片段，让他们不得不回望那座阴森宅邸。

随着追查深入，兄妹逐渐发现，博士慈父般的面孔背后藏着以儿童为对象的残酷实验；玛丽究竟是施害者、共犯，还是试图拯救他们的人，也变得难以判断。被催眠抹去的痛苦、相互猜疑的关系与火灾真相交织，迫使他们直面童年最不愿触碰的黑暗。

当记忆重新拼合，四人终于明白，真正困住他们的并不只是那场大火，而是长期被剥夺的意志、信任与自我。逃离过去未必意味着遗忘；唯有承认伤痕、找回真相，他们才可能重新掌握自己的人生。

26012097.title: Brahms
26012097.official_plot: 1853년 독일 뒤셀도르프. 아직 세상에 이름을 알리지 못한 젊은 음악가 요하네스 브람스는 자신의 음악을 증명하기 위해 뒤셀도르프의 로베르트 슈만을 찾아간다. 브람스의 재능을 단번에 알아본 로베르트 슈만은 그를 새로운 시대를 열 천재라 확신하고 세상에 소개한다. 그리고 그곳에서 브람스는 뛰어난 피아니스트이자 스승의 아내인 클라라 슈만을 만나 음악과 삶을 나누며 서로에게 깊은 영향을 주게 된다. 하지만 명성을 얻어갈수록 브람스 앞에는 예술가로서의 불안과 갈등, 이루어질 수 없는 사랑과 선택의 순간들이 찾아온다. 훗날 화가 막스 클링거는 브람스와의 인연과 그가 남긴 음악을 통해 한 시대를 살아간 예술가의 모습을 기억한다. 사랑과 우정, 열망과 고독 속에서 자신만의 음악을 찾아 위대한 거장으로 나아가는 브람스의 이야기가 시작된다.
checklist: 起點=【1853 年、德國杜塞道夫(뒤셀도르프)】,不是維也納也不是漢堡
布拉姆斯是去【證明自己的音樂】而登門找【羅伯特·舒曼】,不是被邀請
舒曼一眼認出才華,把他當『開啟新時代的天才』介紹給世人
克拉拉的身分要寫全:【傑出鋼琴家】兼【師母(老師的妻子)】
第四個角色是畫家【馬克斯·克林格 Max Klinger】,他是【日後回憶】的敘事框架 —— 不是同代同場的戲份
官方用『이루어질 수 없는 사랑(不可能實現的愛)』,沒有寫成戀情發生;不可寫成兩人相戀或私奔
本製作是【媒體藝術音樂劇】,音樂取材自布拉姆斯與舒曼夫婦的名曲
26012097.note: 傳記劇最容易被 Perplexity 用維基生平填滿(克拉拉守寡、布拉姆斯終身未娶、燒毀手稿等)。官方文本只走到『成為大師的故事開始』,任何具體晚年情節都要當未證實。三語人名要用既有標準譯名(布拉姆斯/勃拉姆斯、舒曼、克拉拉、克林格)。
26012097.en:
Johannes Brahms leaves home in 1853, carrying little more than his talent and a fierce desire to study with the composer he reveres, Robert Alexander Schumann. When he reaches the Schumanns’ household, Robert recognises an exceptional young musician and welcomes him into a world of artistic ambition, intense friendship, and uncompromising ideals. There Brahms hears Clara Schumann play, and her music awakens in him an emotion he cannot easily name: admiration becomes devotion, and devotion becomes a love he believes he has no right to possess.

As Brahms works beside Robert and Clara, the three artists draw inspiration from one another while their private wounds deepen. Robert’s faith in Brahms’s promise gives the younger man confidence, yet Brahms is troubled by the distance between his own aspirations and the greatness expected of him. Clara, a celebrated pianist, bears the pressures of marriage, motherhood, performance, and Robert’s increasingly unstable condition. Brahms tries to suppress his feelings for her, ashamed that his heart has turned toward the wife of the man who has become both mentor and friend.

Robert’s illness worsens into hallucinations and despair, leading him to attempt to take his own life. In the aftermath, Clara struggles with anguish and uncertainty, while Brahms remains at her side, unable to cure her grief yet determined not to abandon her. He turns to composition as the only language capable of holding what cannot be spoken: longing, guilt, loyalty, and love. Observing these lives is the painter Max Klinger, whose perspective frames the artists not merely as celebrated names, but as people driven by the need to leave something truthful behind.

The musical portrays art as both a refuge and a burden: a way to transform suffering without escaping it. It centres on the fragile boundary between love and devotion, and on the cost of pursuing beauty when human relationships cannot be resolved as neatly as music.
26012097.zh:
年輕的約翰尼斯・布拉姆斯懷抱樂譜與對未來的惶惑，在漢堡的街頭與酒館間討生活；他渴望寫出屬於自己的音樂，卻始終懷疑自己是否配得上「作曲家」之名。命運使他結識了備受敬重的作曲家羅伯特・舒曼，以及才華與意志同樣耀眼的鋼琴家克拉拉・舒曼。羅伯特慧眼看出青年的潛力，將他視為能為音樂帶來新聲音的繼承者，並引領他踏入更廣闊的藝術世界。

然而，布拉姆斯在敬仰、感激與自我追尋之間掙扎，也逐漸被克拉拉的演奏、理解與堅韌深深吸引。羅伯特的精神日漸失序，使三人的關係從互相扶持變得脆弱而複雜；友情、愛慕、歉疚與嫉妒交織，令每一次靠近都伴隨難以言說的傷痛。多年後，畫家馬克斯・克林格透過布拉姆斯遺下的信件與音樂，回望這位日後成為大師的青年，試圖拼湊他如何在愛與失落中確立自己的聲音。

布拉姆斯最終明白，藝術並不能抹去人生的遺憾，卻能讓未能說出口的情感持續回響。他帶著對舒曼夫婦的牽繫前行，將孤獨、熱望與告別化為音符，走向屬於自己的道路。
26012097.cn:
年轻的约翰内斯·勃拉姆斯带着尚未成熟的作品与满腔抱负，来到作曲家罗伯特·舒曼家中，希望获得指引。舒曼从他的琴声里听见罕见的才华，决定提携这位初出茅庐的青年；钢琴家克拉拉·舒曼也被他敏锐而炽热的音乐打动。三人因艺术相识，在彼此的理解、赞许与扶持中，逐渐建立起亲密而复杂的联系。

然而，天赋并未立刻消除勃拉姆斯的彷徨。他一面敬仰舒曼，一面急切地想摆脱前辈的影子，找到属于自己的声音；他对克拉拉的感情愈发深沉，却也明白那份靠近牵动着忠诚、责任与难以言明的界限。舒曼的精神困境加深后，三人原有的平衡被打破，爱意、嫉妒、愧疚和艺术理想交织在一起。画家马克斯·克林格以观察者的视角记录他们，将音乐家的内心挣扎、友谊与冲突映照为一段关于创造与自我认同的往事。

当勃拉姆斯必须独自面对失落与抉择时，他终于明白，成熟并不是抹去曾经的依恋，而是将伤痛、敬意与爱化作继续创作的力量。他从不安的青年走向自己的道路，也让那些无法圆满的关系在音乐中获得永恒回响。

26010929.title: 'Cafe-in'
26010929.official_plot: "LOVE IS... 저녁 6시를 경계로 커피와 와인이 공존하는 카페" 카페 'Love is...'의 매니저이자 바리스타 세진은 매일 아침 출근해 칠판에 'Love is...'를 남기며 자신만의 사랑의 정의를 내린다. 반면 저녁에 근무하는 소믈리에 지민은 그 글에 딴지를 거는 반론을 덧적고, 얼굴 한 번 마주치지 않은 두 사람의 유쾌한 신경전이 계속된다. 어느 날 지민은 장난삼아 '정민'이라는 이름으로 세진 앞에 나타나고, 세진은 정체를 모른 채 다정한 정민에게 마음이 기울기 시작한다. 세진을 상대로 지민과 정민을 오가는 이중생활을 하던 지민은, 장난으로 시작했던 거짓말 속에서 지금껏 몰랐던 진짜 사랑의 감정을 마주하게 되는데... 오해와 진실 사이, 두 사람은 사랑의 새로운 정의를 찾아갈 수 있을까?
checklist: 只有【兩名演員】撐 100 分鐘的二人劇(2인극),不可寫成群戲
咖啡館名叫【Love is...】;分界是【晚上 6 點】——之前賣咖啡、之後賣酒
세진:早班【經理兼咖啡師(바리스타)】,每天在黑板寫下自己的『Love is…』定義
지민:晚班【侍酒師(소믈리에)】,在同一塊黑板上寫反駁
關鍵設定:兩人【一次面都沒見過】就靠黑板隔空鬥嘴
轉折:지민 惡作劇般用【'정민'】這個【假名】現身;세진 不知情而對『정민』動心
지민 過的是【지민/정민 兩個身分的雙重生活】,對象是 세진
官方以問句收在『兩人能否找到愛的新定義』——【沒有】給出結局,不可自行寫成告白成功/分手
26010929.note: ⚠ 這齣入選【2024 K-Musical Roadshow in Taipei】、並有日本(東京/大阪)巡演 —— 台灣可能有官方中文劇名,標題那一輪要回頭查(目前 i18n_maps 未收)。另 Perplexity 很容易把二人劇寫成有店員/客人等配角,要盯。
26010929.en:
Each morning, Sejin unlocks the doors of the cafe Love is..., grinds the coffee beans, and writes a new answer to the words “Love is...” on the chalkboard. She is the cafe’s manager and barista, devoted to the daytime world of espresso, quiet routines, and a romantic ideal she cannot quite put into practice. At six o’clock, the space changes hands: wine replaces coffee, and Jimin, the night-shift sommelier, takes over. Although they never meet, he cannot resist answering Sejin’s earnest chalkboard declarations with teasing objections. Their written exchanges soon become a lively private battle between two people who know each other only through handwriting, wit, and opposing opinions about love.

Curious about the woman behind the board, Jimin visits during the day while pretending to be a customer. Rather than give his real name, he introduces himself as Jeongmin. Sejin, charmed by the considerate coffee lover who seems to understand her, begins to fall for “Jeongmin,” unaware that he is the same irritating sommelier who mocks her messages every evening. Jimin then finds himself caught between two identities: as Jimin, he keeps sparring with Sejin through the chalkboard; as Jeongmin, he offers her warmth, encouragement, and eventually advice on how to pursue the very man he is pretending to be.

What begins as a prank grows increasingly difficult to control. Jimin’s deception brings Sejin closer to him, yet it also builds the misunderstanding that may hurt her most. As their unseen rivalry becomes intimacy and the cafe’s divided hours draw their lives together, both must confront whether affection founded on a lie can become honest love.

The musical treats love as both coffee and wine: bitter, sweet, stimulating, and capable of lingering long after the first taste. Its central themes are the gap between fantasy and truth, the vulnerability beneath flirtation, and the courage required to be known without disguise.
26010929.zh:
白天的「Love is…」咖啡館裡，咖啡師世珍一面沖煮咖啡，一面在門口黑板寫下自己對愛情的註解。她有個苦澀的魔咒：每段戀情結束後，前男友總會與下一位對象步入婚姻，讓她自嘲是「倒數第二個女人」。她仍眷戀逝去的感情，卻也渴望有人能真正讀懂她的寂寞與真心。

傍晚六點後，店面換上酒香，風流自信的侍酒師志敏接手經營。他發現黑板上的文字，便以不同意見留言反駁，與從未謀面的世珍展開一場關於愛情的筆談。好奇心驅使志敏假扮成溫柔體貼的客人「正敏」接近世珍；夜裡，他是能傾聽心事的同事志敏，白天則是讓她一見傾心的完美紳士正敏。

世珍逐漸陷入這段看似命中注定的戀情，志敏卻在玩笑、隱瞞與真心之間愈陷愈深。當雙重身分無法再維持，謊言帶來的傷害迫使兩人正視各自對愛情的恐懼。咖啡的苦與酒的餘韻，映照出他們既想靠近、又害怕受傷的心。

在黑板一句句未完成的「Love is…」之間，兩人終於明白，愛不是精心扮演的理想角色，而是願意坦露不完美的自己。唯有跨出誠實的一步，才可能讓短暫的心動沉澱為真正的相守。
26010929.cn:
白天，咖啡师金世珍独自在“Love is…”咖啡馆忙碌，习惯每天在黑板上写下自己对爱情的定义。她看似开朗自信，心里却藏着屡次成为男友“前任的前一任”的失落；一到夜晚，店铺便由自称情场高手的侍酒师姜智民接手，咖啡的香气让位于葡萄酒的醇香。

素未谋面的两人共用同一间店，却先在黑板上交锋。世珍写下关于爱情的感想，智民总在夜里留下针锋相对的反驳；从一字一句的斗嘴，到不断猜测对方身份，他们对这个神秘“同店人”愈发在意。智民为了确认世珍的反应，白天装作普通客人走进店里点单，风趣体贴的“郑敏”很快获得她的好感。世珍不知道，眼前温柔的客人和夜里在黑板上抬杠的侍酒师，原来是同一个人。

随着相处加深，智民在真实身份与精心塑造的形象之间周旋，世珍也在心动、怀疑与旧伤中反复拉扯。黑板上的爱情辩论逐渐逼近两人不敢直说的真心，谎言一旦被揭开，甜蜜便不得不接受信任的考验。

咖啡和葡萄酒口味不同，却都带着令人上瘾的余韵。世珍与智民最终明白，爱情并非完美人设或漂亮答案，而是愿意坦白缺点、接住彼此不安的勇气。

26012259.title: LET ME FLY
26012259.official_plot: 아폴로 11호가 달을 향해 쏘아 올려진 1969년의 밤. 동네 최고의 수선장이 남원은 편지 한 통을 받으며 불가능할 것만 같았던 패션 디자이너라는 꿈에 한 발짝 다가선다. 사랑하는 정분이와의 멋진 내일을 꿈꾸던 남원은 점점 커지는 달에 놀라 쓰러지고 다시 눈을 뜬 곳은 2020년의 어느 날! 당황스럽고 어리둥절한 남원 앞에 '영감, 지금은 2020년이고, 우린 70이야!' 말하는 선희 할머니가 나타난다. 2020년이 낯선 듯 익숙한 남원. 어떻게든 사랑하는 정분이가 있는 1969년으로 돌아가기 위한 미래 탐사를 시작한다.
checklist: 起點=【1969 年阿波羅 11 號升空那一夜】,남원 是村裡最好的【裁縫/修補匠(수선장이)】
那封信=【국제복장학원 입학통지서】(服裝學院錄取通知),不是別的信
兩人的夢:남원→서울 최고의【패션 디자이너】;정분→【우주비행사/우주과학자】(NASA 有女科學家)
他被越來越大的月亮嚇到昏倒,醒來是【2020 年】、自己【70 歲】
선희 稱他【영감】並自稱【마누라(妻子)】
🚨 全劇關鍵反轉:【선희 就是 정분,同一個人,名字因故改了】—— 官方 SYNOPSIS 刻意不寫,但外部 4 個獨立來源(含演員本人專訪)一致確認
結局:추남원 找回全部記憶、認出 선희 就是 정분,兩人相望對唱(〈내 눈에 담긴 모습〉)
老年南原與青年南原【同台】,是兩個演員分飾
創作團隊:연출 이대웅 / 작·작사 조민형 / 작곡·편곡 민찬홍;2020 우란문화재단 tryout → 2022 초연 → 2023 재연 → 2026.10.06~2027.01.03 삼연(두산아트센터 연강홀)
26012259.note: 劇名查證補強:台灣、香港都演過,連【C Musical 的中文版】都直接沿用《Let Me Fly》不另譯 —— 保留原文的決定得到三個華語市場的實例佐證(titles_ledger 原本只寫『劇名本體就是英文片語』,證據等級可升)。⚠ Perplexity 若把 선희/정분 寫成兩個不同的女人,是【錯的】;若寫成同一人,是【對的】不要改。
26012259.en:
Namwon stretches toward the night sky, struggling to tune a radio as Apollo 11 races toward the moon in 1969. A gifted repairman with a long-suppressed dream of becoming a fashion designer, he has just received a letter that seems to bring that impossible future within reach. Beside him is Jeongbun, the young woman he loves, whose own ambition is to explore the moon as an astronaut. As the pair imagine leaving for Seoul and building a brighter tomorrow, the full moon swells unnaturally overhead. Namwon collapses beneath its light.

He wakes in 2020, no longer young but a seventy-year-old man in the same cramped lodging-house room. The future is both unfamiliar and disturbingly intimate: he runs a small alterations shop rather than living the life of fashion he once envisioned, and an elderly woman named Seonhee calls him Halabeom. Namwon cannot understand where the decades have gone, why Jeongbun is absent, or how this quiet life could possibly be his. Determined to return to 1969 before the future hardens around him, he begins an urgent search through the strange world that has become his present.

As Namwon confronts his older self and listens to Seonhee, fragments of the years he cannot remember begin to surface. Past and present overlap through remembered objects, everyday routines, lost aspirations, and the enduring traces of Jeongbun. The more fiercely Namwon tries to reclaim the future he imagined with her, the more he must face the choices, sacrifices, disappointments, and unexpected happiness that formed the life he actually lived. What first appears to be a comic journey through time becomes a reckoning with love, memory, and the meaning of an ordinary life.

At its heart, the musical treats life as a time journey made from small choices rather than perfect achievements. It suggests that dreams may change shape, but love and shared days can give even an imperfect life its lasting radiance.
26012259.zh:
1969年阿波羅11號飛向月球的夜晚，小鎮修補師南原伸長手臂調整收音機頻率，與鄭芬一同聽著登月消息。他懷抱成為服裝設計師的夢想，意外收到國際服裝學院的錄取通知；鄭芬也嚮往進入美國太空總署、親自飛向宇宙。兩人相約翌日搭火車前往首爾，在城市裡追逐各自的未來。

然而，南原獨自仰望愈發逼近的滿月時忽然昏倒；再次醒來，他竟成了七十歲老人，墜入陌生的2020年。眼前的善熙奶奶似乎早已認識他，卻對他的困惑與衝動既無奈又耐心。為了回到仍在1969年等候的鄭芬身旁，南原開始一場荒唐卻真切的「未來探查」，試圖理解時間為何將他推往多年以後。

在穿梭於過去、現在與未來的過程中，年輕的南原、年老的自己、善熙與鄭芬逐漸交會。那些曾以為理所當然的夢、未能說出口的心意，以及人生岔路上的選擇，也在重逢與錯身之間被重新看見。

南原終於明白，回到某個年月未必能改寫所有遺憾，但能使人更誠實地面對愛與告別。這趟追尋月光的旅程，讓每個人重新確認：即使人生無法如願飛翔，仍能選擇朝珍視的人與夢想伸出手。
26012259.cn:
1969年阿波罗11号飞向月球的夜晚，镇上最好的裁缝南原收到服装学院的录取通知，正要与恋人贞粉相约次日赴首尔，追逐时装设计师的梦想。两人憧憬未来，贞粉也决定同行；然而，南原在月光下忽然昏倒，再睁眼竟置身2020年。陌生的城市里，人们手握手机，一位名叫善姬的老太太却叫他“老头子”。更令他难以接受的是，他已年届七十，身边没有贞粉，自己仍靠缝补衣物度日，而善姬竟是相伴多年的妻子。

南原坚信这是意外的时空错位，执意搜集“未来情报”，寻找回到1969年的方法，准备改写命运、回到贞粉身边。善姬陪着他展开一场笨拙又热闹的“未来探查”，年轻的南原与年老的自己、等待中的贞粉也在记忆与想象中彼此照映。随着往昔被重新拼接，他渐渐发现，那些以为被辜负的选择、没能实现的梦想，以及身边平凡却长久的陪伴，都藏着另一种答案。

南原最终面对的不只是回到过去的难题，更是如何理解自己走过的一生。穿越时间的奇遇，让他重新辨认爱情、遗憾与当下的珍贵。

26009512.title: Let the Cheongsachorong Shine!
26009512.official_plot: 조선 최고의 혼례 업체 '청사초롱'. 청사초롱의 행수 윤덕은 타고난 미적 감각과 카리스마로 청사초롱을 이끌어 가며, '세상에 단 하나뿐인 특별한 혼례를 만들어주겠다'는 목표를 가지고 있다. 오랜 만에 청사초롱의 새로운 혼례가 있는 날. 도성 밖까지 구경꾼이 늘어설 정도의 화려한 혼례가 끝난 후, 윤덕을 찾아온 의문의 청년 노들. 노들은 윤덕에게 자기 어머니의 혼례식을 올려 달라 의뢰한다. 일찍 남편을 잃고 아들을 키우는데 평생을 바친 어머니의 새로운 사랑을 축하해주고 싶다는 뜻을 밝히는 노들. 하지만 현재는 과부의 재가가 법적으로 금지되어있는 상황이다. 평민들이야 나라의 눈을 피해 조용히 재가를 할 수 있다 쳐도, 세상 사람 모두가 알도록 혼례를 올리는 것은 다른 문제. 잘못하면 청사초롱마저 곤란해질 수 있는 상황에 윤덕의 오른팔인 수두매는 노들의 의뢰를 받아들이지 말자고 한다. 하지만 그런 노들에게 질문 하나를 던지는 윤덕. 어머니께서 진정 혼례를 원하시는지, 그리고 원하신다면 그 이유가 무엇인지. 질문에 대한 답을 가져온다면 의뢰를 받아들이겠다는 윤덕의 말에, 노들은 고민에 빠진다. 한편 청사초롱 주변을 배회하는 수상한 그림자. 청나라에서 유명한 상인 로랑과, 그의 통역사 지남이다. 로랑은 윤덕에게 청사초롱을 인수해서 세계적으로 키워나가고 싶다는 뜻을 밝히지만, 지남의 통역 과정에서 오해가 생긴다. 로랑 또한 윤덕에 대한 오해만 키운 채 청사초롱을 떠나게 되고, 지남은 로랑에게 청사초롱을 차지할 수 있는 새로운 계획을 알려준다. 한편 노들은 어머니와의 대화를 통해 윤덕의 질문에 대한 답을 찾고, 윤덕이 노들의 의뢰를 받아들이며 청사초롱은 바쁘게 움직이기 시작한다.
checklist: 設定=【朝鮮時代的婚禮公司『청사초롱』】,概念是『如果朝鮮時代就有婚禮企劃師』
윤덕:女性,青紗燈籠的【행수(當家)】,朝鮮第一婚禮企劃師
노들:年輕男子,來委託【自己寡母的婚禮】,理由是想祝福母親的新戀情
核心衝突=【寡婦再嫁在當時是法律禁止的】;偷偷改嫁可以,大張旗鼓辦婚禮是另一回事
수두매(윤덕的左右手)【反對】接這個委託
윤덕開的條件:去問清楚【母親是不是真的想辦、想辦的理由是什麼】,帶答案回來才接
副線:清國名商【로랑】與其通譯【지남】想收購青紗燈籠推向世界,但【지남的翻譯造成誤會】;로랑帶著誤解離開,지남 另獻併吞之計
官方文本收在『노들找到答案、윤덕接下委託、청사초롱開始忙碌』——【沒有】寫婚禮辦成沒有
26009512.note: ⚠ 一處外部矛盾:Facebook 觀後感(오판진)把행수寫成【윤담】,與官方詳情圖、Instagram 卡司表的【윤덕】不符 —— 官方 2 源 vs 個人 1 源,採【윤덕】。另外 Instagram 那場的卡司名(임오/이철/곤지/양평/가평)與官方 Synopsis 提到的(수두매/로랑/지남)不重疊,判斷是官方頁只放主角、IG 是完整卡司,不算矛盾。劇名依政策保留原文(官方英文名自己就把 Cheongsachorong 留羅馬拼音)。
26009512.en:
Yundeok is preparing another immaculate celebration at Cheongsachorong, Joseon's most sought-after marriage house, when Nodeul arrives with an extraordinary commission. He wants a wedding for his widowed mother, who has spent years alone keeping her tavern and raising him. In a society where remarriage is forbidden, the request risks scandal as well as punishment, but Nodeul refuses to accept that his mother's life should end with widowhood. Moved by his determination, Yundeok promises to create a ceremony worthy of her long-silenced hopes.

Yundeok rallies Cheongsachorong's spirited specialists: Imo, an ingenious problem-solver; Icheol, the fashion-conscious master of scissors; Gonji, who fashions a bride's beauty; and singers Yangpyeong and Gapyeong. Together they turn preparations for an illicit second marriage into a daring campaign of costumes, flowers, music, gifts, and carefully managed secrets. As the household works, Nodeul's mother must confront not merely public disapproval but her own fear of choosing joy after years defined by loss and duty.

Their plans become still more precarious when Laurent, a wealthy Qing merchant, takes an interest in Cheongsachorong. He proposes acquiring the business and expanding it beyond Joseon, yet his intentions are distorted through the interpretations of Jinam, the official translator accompanying him. Misunderstandings multiply, mistrust grows, and Jinam devises a scheme that could let Laurent seize Cheongsachorong for himself. With the wedding approaching, Yundeok must defend both the company and the couple's right to stand before their community and receive its blessing. The festivity becomes a test of whether custom will yield to compassion, and whether a ceremony can honor a love society has tried to deny.

At its heart, the musical celebrates the desire to be loved, recognized, and blessed rather than merely to satisfy the institution of marriage. It contrasts restrictive convention and commercial ambition with quiet sincerity, family devotion, and the courage to begin again.
26009512.zh:
暖黃燈籠搖曳的漢陽街頭，朝鮮最負盛名的婚禮策劃行「青紗燭籠」正忙著張羅一場獨一無二的喜宴。掌櫃尹德眼光犀利、氣勢十足，堅信每對新人都該擁有貼合自身心意的婚禮；他與一群身懷絕技的夥伴，從妝髮、剪裁、禮俗到迎親排場，將婚嫁大事化為熱鬧又精巧的專業工程。這時，青年老들找上門，懇求他們替守寡多年的母親籌辦再婚婚禮。

在禮法森嚴的年代，寡婦再嫁不只牽動母子心願，也招來旁人的指點與阻撓。尹德一行人決定接下委託，卻必須在傳統規矩、家族顧慮與新人的真情之間周旋。另一方面，想收購「青紗燭籠」、將其推向海外的羅朗到訪，透過翻譯志南傳話時頻頻產生誤會，更讓原本井然有序的婚禮計畫節外生枝。

隨著籌備步步推進，眾人不僅得想辦法化解衝突，也重新思索婚禮究竟是遵循形式的儀式，還是讓相愛的人坦然接受祝福的時刻。喜劇般的忙亂與熱鬧歌舞之中，每個人都逐漸說出藏在心裡的願望。

當青紅燈火終於點亮，這場婚禮見證的不只是兩人的結合，更是跨越成見、重新選擇幸福的勇氣。全劇以歡騰婚宴收束，讓祝福成為照亮人心的光。
26009512.cn:
在朝鲜王朝的京城，青年诺德敲开婚礼策划行“青纱灯笼”的大门，急切请求掌柜尹德替守寡多年的母亲操办一场体面的再婚典礼。尹德以挑剔的眼光和过人的气场统领众人，坚信婚礼不该只是循规蹈矩的仪式，而应让每一对新人都拥有独一无二的喜庆时刻。于是，剪裁、梳妆、迎亲、摆宴等人手迅速集结，一桩看似寻常的委托渐渐变成全店上下的大工程。

筹备途中，诺德母亲与张大叔的感情既真挚又羞涩，面对流言和礼俗，他们不得不重新确认自己是否有权追求晚来的幸福。与此同时，初到朝鲜的清商人罗朗带着收购“青纱灯笼”、将其发展为大生意的打算而来；语言传达中的偏差、经营理念的冲突，以及各人对婚姻不同的期待，使热闹的筹婚现场不断横生枝节。众人有时忙着掩藏婚宴上的意外，有时替新人化解尴尬，也在笑闹中看见彼此难以言明的孤独与愿望。

当红蓝纱灯终于被点亮，婚礼不再只是两个人的结合，也成了家人与邻里重新学习祝福的场合。尹德和伙伴们用一场尽力而为的仪式证明：无论年纪、身份或经历如何，每个人都值得被郑重迎向幸福。

26006810.title: The Origin of Species
26006810.official_plot: 수영만이 유일한 피난처이자 삶의 낙인 유진. 그런 유진을 괴롭히는 건 의사인 이모가 내린 간질 진단과 '리모트'라는 약이다. <도하 아시안 게임 대표 선발전> 대회 경기 중 찾아온 발작. 이 사건으로 어머니와 이모에 의해 수영을 금지당한 유진은 리모트를 끊고 밤에 몰래 외출하는 것을 유일한 위안으로 삼는다. 어느 날 죽은 형 유민과 똑 닮은 외모를 가졌다는 이유만으로 입양된 해진의 전화를 받고 잠에서 깬 유진이 발견한 것은 어머니의 시체. 그리고 이어지는 의문의 살인 사건과 사건의 진상을 파헤치는 유진. 하지만 진실에 다가갈수록 가까워지는 어두운 과거와 현재. 정체를 알 수 없는 약과 '어머니'의 철저한 규칙, 어느 날 가족이 되어버린 '해진', 그리고 유진을 마음대로 조종하는 듯한 '이모'의 감시. 유진과 그를 둘러싼 가족들에게는 과연 무슨 일이 있었던 걸까... 어머니의 죽음으로 조금씩 드러나는 과거의 비밀들! 유진의 선택은?
checklist: 主角【한유진】,游泳是他唯一的避難所;『물속은 온전한 나만의 세상』
折磨他的是【身為醫生的阿姨(이모)】下的【癲癇(간질)】診斷,以及叫【리모트(Remote)】的藥
發作發生在【도하 아시안 게임 대표 선발전】的比賽中
此後被母親與阿姨【禁止游泳】,他停藥、夜裡偷溜出門
【해진】是因為長得跟【死去的哥哥 유민】一模一樣才被收養的
他是接到 해진 的電話醒來,才發現【母親的屍體】
四個角色而已:한유진 / 김해진 / 김지원(母) / 김혜원(姨);母與姨【由同一位演員分飾】
🚨【한유진 是 2 人 1 役】—— 同一個舞台上同時有兩位演員演俞鎮(藍俞鎮/紅俞鎮),其中一個是停藥時只有他看得見的『另一個自己』
🚨【與原著小說的差異】(寫簡介時絕不能照小說寫):①腦中的『청군과 백군』在劇裡具象成看得見的另一個自己;②小說後段的【交通事故】在劇裡改成【유진與해진的投身(跳下)】
官方文本收在問句『유진의 선택은?』——【沒有】揭曉兇手是誰
26006810.note: 🚨 這齣最大的陷阱是【拿小說劇情當音樂劇劇情寫】。namu 有專節列出改編差異,尤其結局從車禍改成投身。另外 2 人 1 役是本劇的招牌形式,簡介若寫成單一主角會漏掉核心。中文劇名:繁體採《物種起源》(台灣凱特文化 2018 譯本,譯者馬毓玲);簡體【不加】—— 該詞在簡中已被達爾文原著佔用,會誤配。
26006810.en:
Yujin wakes to a call from Haejin and steps into a home shattered by violence: his mother, Jiwon, lies brutally murdered. The discovery tears open a life Yujin has tried to keep orderly and forgettable. Once a gifted swimmer, he lost the sport that had been his one refuge after suffering a seizure during the Doha Asian Games national-team trials. His mother and his aunt, Hyewon, a doctor, responded by forbidding him to swim and placing him on a drug called Remote, insisting that his illness and impulses must be controlled.

Now living as a law-school applicant, Yujin has learned to endure the rules imposed on him. He secretly stops taking Remote and slips out at night, seeking a fragile sense of freedom beyond the surveillance of Jiwon and Hyewon. Haejin, a gentle and attentive film student, is Yujin's only close friend. Yet Haejin's place in the family is unsettling: he was taken in because he bears an uncanny resemblance to Yumin, Yujin's dead older brother.

As further suspicious deaths and buried memories emerge, Yujin begins tracing the links among the murder, the medication, his family's strict discipline, and the past that everyone around him has concealed. Every answer destabilizes his sense of himself. The investigation becomes inseparable from a more frightening question: whether the darkness pressing in on him comes from the people who have controlled his life, or from a violent nature within him that has been waiting to surface. In confronting the truth about Jiwon, Hyewon, Haejin, and Yumin, Yujin must decide what he is willing to acknowledge—and what he will become.

The musical examines the collision between control and instinct, asking whether cruelty is inherited, awakened, or created through fear and confinement. It also turns family into a site of both protection and manipulation, where self-knowledge arrives through terror rather than comfort.
26006810.zh:
韓宥真在游泳選拔賽的跳水台前屏息備戰，卻在最關鍵的一刻突遭發作，從此被迫放棄曾是生命全部的泳池。多年後，他依舊按醫囑服藥，住在母親金知媛嚴密規訓的家中；精神科醫師姨媽金惠媛不斷監控他的狀態，而被收養、外貌酷似亡兄的海鎮，則是他身邊少數溫暖的存在。

某日清晨，海鎮來電詢問家中是否出了事。宥真醒來才發現自己滿身血跡、記憶殘缺，樓下更躺著遭殘忍殺害的母親。隨著另一樁命案傳出，他一面設法拼湊昨夜的空白，一面追查藏在家族往事、藥物與自身病症背後的真相。那些被壓抑的衝動、童年創傷與難以言說的聲音逐漸回返，迫使他正視自己究竟是受害者，還是最危險的加害者。

在現實與內心幻象交錯之間，宥真一步步剝開被安排的人生，也逐漸靠近自己不願承認的本性。當記憶終於完整，他必須面對的已不只是殺人事件的真相，而是人如何在恐懼、控制與自由之間，選擇成為什麼樣的存在。
26006810.cn:
游泳赛场上，少年韩宥真刚以破纪录的成绩完成预赛，正准备迎接关键一战，却突然痉挛倒下。姑妈惠媛以医生身份诊断他患有癫痫，母亲智媛随即强迫他长期服用“利莫特”，并禁止他再碰泳池。药物带来的昏沉与束缚，使宥真从备受期待的运动员沦为循规蹈矩的法学院考生；他唯有瞒着家人深夜外出，短暂逃离被监视和操控的生活。

一天清晨，养兄金海镇打来电话，焦急地说联系不上母亲。宥真醒来后走进遍布血迹的家，发现智媛惨遭杀害。面对警方调查、海镇的关切和惠媛若有若无的控制，他开始回溯自己断片般的记忆：比赛日的发作、偷偷停药后的夜游、母亲留下的记录，以及这个家庭长期掩埋的秘密。越接近真相，他越怀疑凶手并非外人，也越无法确认自己究竟是受害者、目击者，还是早已被压抑的罪行执行者。

两位“韩宥真”在舞台上彼此对峙：一个试图拼凑事实、维持理性，另一个则不断诱惑他承认欲望与暴力。随着母亲死亡的谜团被逐层揭开，他终于直面被药物、家庭规则和自我谎言遮蔽多年的本能。

当宥真不再逃避内心深处的黑暗，真相也显出令人战栗的面目。故事将一场家庭惨案化为对人性、控制与恶意如何滋生的冷酷追问。

26009625.title: Gwanghwamun Love Song
26009625.official_plot: 생을 떠나기 전 1분, 마지막으로 보고싶은 사람과 그리운 추억을 다시 만날 수 있다면?! 병원 응급실이 아닌, '기억의 전시관'에서 눈을 뜬 명우. 삶의 출구이며 죽음의 입구인 그곳에서 추억을 되감아주는 '기억 마스터'이자, 인연을 관장하는 '인연술사' 월하의 안내에 따라 되돌아가고 싶은 스무 살의 추억으로 떠난다. 옛 사랑 소녀를 만나, 타오르는 붉은노을을 바라보며 사랑을 외치고, 못다 이룬 사랑이 지나가면, 애수가 찾아 들던 그때 그 시절. 기억 속 명우 자신의 모습은 찬란하게 빛나고, 애틋하고, 소중하지만 때때로 부끄럽고, 어쩌면 조작되기도 하는데... 당신이 마지막으로 REPLAY할 인생의 챕터는 언제인가요?
checklist: 體裁=【已故作曲家 이영훈 的點唱機音樂劇(주크박스)】,選的是他寫『人生、愛情、藝術』主題的歌
框架:명우 在【嚥氣前的一分鐘】,醒來的地方不是急診室而是【기억의 전시관(記憶展示館)】
월하 的身分要寫全:【기억 마스터】兼掌管緣分的【인연술사】(名字取自月下老人)
他回去的是【二十歲】那段記憶,初戀是【수아】
外部補充:兩人初遇是【1984 年春天德壽宮寫生大會】(官方頁沒寫,更뮤지컬 有)
官方那段『소녀 / 붉은노을 / 사랑이 지나가면 / 애수』其實是把【이영훈 的歌名】嵌進句子裡的排版設計,不是劇情人物 —— 三語都不可把『소녀(少女)』當成一個角色名
官方點出記憶【也可能被竄改(조작되기도)】,這是本劇的自省母題
2026 這一輪的重心是【面對死亡、自己收束一生、有尊嚴地離開】,不是單純懷舊初戀
結尾是問句『你最後要 REPLAY 的人生篇章是哪一段?』
26009625.note: 🚨 最大陷阱:官方 SYNOPSIS 裡『옛 사랑 소녀를 만나, 타오르는 붉은노을을…못다 이룬 사랑이 지나가면, 애수가 찾아 들던』整句是把〈소녀〉〈붉은 노을〉〈사랑이 지나가면〉〈애수〉四首歌名藏進文句的文案手法(原圖上這四組字用了不同字體/顏色標示)。若照字面翻譯會生出一個不存在的角色『少女』。另 namu 條目名帶【CJ ENM】消歧義,代表另有同名作品,查證時不可混。
26009625.en:
Myeong-woo opens his eyes in the Memory Exhibition Hall with only a minute of life remaining. At the threshold of death, he meets Wol-ha, the enigmatic master of memories and keeper of human connections, who offers to lead him back through the moments that have shaped him. As the present-day composer revisits his past, his younger self reappears: a shy art student whose life changes when he encounters Su-a at a spring sketching contest in Deoksugung.

Bright, forthright, and impossible to ignore, Su-a draws the young Myeong-woo into days of friendship and tentative romance. Their shared time in and around Gwanghwamun carries the promise of a first love, yet the political unrest surrounding them soon forces a division between private feeling and public conscience. Myeong-woo witnesses Su-a at a demonstration and sees her beaten and taken away during the violent suppression of the protesters. Unable to protect her, he is left with a guilt that he cannot voice and an increasingly painful distance between them.

Myeong-woo enters military service while Su-a commits herself to the movement, and the path that might have joined them slips away. Guided by Wol-ha through recollections that shift between tenderness, fantasy, and unbearable regret, the older Myeong-woo confronts the rooms and absences within his memory, including the love he never fully understood, his long marriage to Si-yeong, and Su-a’s later life with Jung-gon. The journey compels him to face not only what he lost, but also the choices, fears, and silences that made those losses permanent.

At its heart, the musical considers how love survives in memory even when it cannot survive in life. It is a farewell shaped by first love, remorse, mortality, and the possibility of accepting one’s past before the final moment arrives.
26009625.zh:
病榻上的中年作曲家明宇在生命只剩最後一分鐘時，於「記憶展示館」醒來。掌管緣分的神祕術士月河現身，引領他走進一段段最想回去的往日；明宇循著記憶回到二十歲，重返1980年代的首爾，望見年少的自己在音樂、友誼與動盪時局之間徬徨前行。

年輕的明宇懷抱創作夢想，在光化門一帶邂逅讓他難以忘懷的秀兒。兩人隨著歌聲與季節並肩漫遊，愛意在青春的燦爛裡悄然滋長；然而理想、現實與時代留下的傷痕，也逐步改變他們的命運。明宇一面重溫初戀最炙熱的片刻，一面看見當年未能說出口的心意、錯過的選擇，以及自己始終不願面對的遺憾。

月河讓記憶、幻象與現實不斷交疊，令明宇不只是旁觀者，更必須與不同年歲的自己相遇。他在回憶中追尋秀兒，也重新理解那些曾以為失去的人與事，如何長久塑造了此後的人生。最終，這趟倒轉時光的旅程不在於改寫過去，而是讓他學會告別。

當最後一分鐘即將流逝，明宇明白最珍貴的未必是能重來的青春，而是曾真心愛過、也曾被愛的每個瞬間。月河帶他穿越的，是一首關於初戀、遺憾與和解的人生情歌。
26009625.cn:
急救室里，作曲家明宇在生命垂危之际接受最后一次心肺复苏，意识却来到收藏人生记忆的神秘空间。掌管人与人缘分的月下现身，带他在最后一分钟里倒回往昔，寻找那间始终空置于记忆深处的“房子”，也重新面对未能说出口的爱与歉意。

1984年春天，还是美术系学生的年轻明宇在德寿宫写生比赛上邂逅率真开朗的秀雅。两人沿着首尔的街巷相识相恋，分享对未来的憧憬。然而，时代的动荡很快闯入他们的青春：明宇目睹秀雅参加学生运动，在光化门遭到暴力镇压并被带走，却没能保护她。无力感与愧疚使他逐渐退缩；此后他入伍，秀雅则更坚定地投身社会运动，彼此相爱的两人终于在现实与选择面前渐行渐远。

月下带着中年明宇穿行于昔日场景，幻象、现实与回忆不断交错。他不仅重见秀雅，也看见后来成为妻子的诗英，明白自己长期沉溺于初恋的遗憾，忽略了始终陪伴身边的人。

当生命走到尽头，明宇终于懂得，遗憾未必能够改写，却可以被诚实地告别。那些错过的人、未完成的爱与留在心底的歌，终将成为他与人生和解的最后一程。

26006751.title: Park Yeol
26006751.official_plot: 1923년, 관동대지진으로 붕괴된 도쿄에 괴소문이 퍼진다. "조선인이 지진을 틈타 폭동을 일으키고 있다!" 그로 인해 조선인 6천명이 학살되자 도쿄재판소 검사국장 류지에게 특명이 떨어진다. "조선인 대학살 사건을 덮을 사건을 찾아라!" 그 계략에 들어온 건, 조선인 아나키스트 박열과 그의 일본인 아내 가네코 후미코. 류지가 박열의 폭탄 계획을 과장하려 들자 계략을 눈치챈 두 사람은 황태자 저격 의도를 자백하며 대역죄인을 자처한다. "우리를 사형하라!" 이제 열도를 뒤흔들 초유의 재판이 시작된다!
checklist: 起點=【1923 年關東大地震】後的東京,謠言『朝鮮人趁地震暴動』
【朝鮮人 6 千人遭屠殺】—— 官方文本明寫這個數字
류지 的職稱是【도쿄재판소 검사국장(東京審判所檢事局長)】,接到的密令是『找一個事件來蓋掉朝鮮人大屠殺』
🚨 류지 全名【요시다 류지(吉田龍二)】是【虛構人物】,象徵日本帝國 —— 不可寫成真實歷史人物
박열=朝鮮人無政府主義者;가네코 후미코=他的【日本人妻子】
轉折:류지 想【誇大】박열 的炸彈計畫;兩人識破,反過來【自白有狙擊皇太子的意圖】、自稱大逆罪人
台詞『우리를 사형하라!(把我們處死!)』是全劇核心
官方收在『撼動列島的空前審判就此開始』——【沒有】寫判決與結局
🚨 這是【三人劇】:只有 박열、후미코、류지 三個角色
⚠ 同題材另有一齣音樂劇《22년 2개월》(2023 초연),角色更多 —— 不可混寫
26006751.note: 傳記題材,Perplexity 極可能用【2017 年李濬益電影《朴烈》】或維基生平來填(如出獄後的人生、韓戰期間北送、1974 年在北韓過世)。官方文本只到審判開始,任何審判結果/晚年情節都要當未證實。中文劇名採【朴烈】(中文維基與 2017 電影台譯一致,繁簡同名)。
26006751.en:
Rumours race through the shattered streets of Tokyo after the Great Kanto Earthquake of 1923: Koreans are said to be plotting violence amid the chaos. As the lie feeds panic and enables the massacre of Korean residents, public scrutiny begins to threaten the authorities. Ryuji, head of the Tokyo Prosecutors' Office, receives a blunt order: find a sensational case powerful enough to divert attention from the killings.

His search turns to Park Yeol, a Korean anarchist committed to resisting imperial power, and Kaneko Fumiko, his Japanese wife and comrade. The authorities seize on fragments of an alleged bomb plot, intending to inflate them into an exemplary prosecution. Arrested and interrogated, Park Yeol and Fumiko quickly understand that they have been selected as convenient villains in a state-made spectacle. Rather than merely deny the accusation, they decide to seize control of the role imposed upon them.

Before the court, the pair proclaim that they intended to assassinate the Crown Prince and demand the death penalty, transforming Ryuji's carefully engineered case into a public confrontation with the Japanese state. Their defiance turns the trial into a platform for their anarchist conviction that no person should rule over another, and that Koreans and Japanese alike deserve freedom and dignity. Yet the authorities fear that executions would make the two into martyrs. The sentences are commuted, and Park Yeol and Fumiko are separated in prison. Fumiko dies in captivity; years later, following Korea's liberation, Park Yeol is released, carrying the memory of their shared struggle.

The musical centres on resistance to state violence, the manipulation of truth, and the courage to turn persecution into testimony. It also portrays love and solidarity across nationality as a force that endures even when power tries to isolate, silence, and erase its opponents.
26006751.zh:
1923年關東大地震後的東京滿目瘡痍，謠言卻指稱朝鮮人趁亂暴動，無數朝鮮人因而遭到屠殺。東京法院檢察局長柳地奉命另造轟動案件，以掩蓋屠殺真相，便將矛頭指向在日朝鮮青年、無政府主義者朴烈，以及與他並肩生活的日本女性金子文子。兩人相信人不該屈從於國家與權力的壓迫，也在困頓生活中彼此確認了革命理想與愛情。

柳地刻意誇大朴烈的炸彈計畫，企圖將兩人塑造成威脅皇室的要犯。看穿當局盤算的朴烈與文子，反而承認意圖狙擊皇太子，自願成為「大逆罪」被告，要求法庭判處死刑；他們要讓這場被安排的審判，反過來揭開日本政府的暴力與虛偽。面對檢方威嚇、輿論操弄與牢獄隔絕，文子仍以堅定的宣言捍衛自由，朴烈也拒絕被塑造成順從的罪人。

死刑判決隨後引發國際關注，政府改判兩人無期徒刑，並將他們分別囚禁。無法相見的距離，未能摧毀兩人對彼此與理想的承諾。

全劇在國家權力的陰影下，刻畫朴烈與金子文子把審判化為反抗舞台的選擇。他們以不願屈服的姿態，留下關於自由、愛與信念的沉重提問。
26006751.cn:
1923年，关东大地震后的东京满目疮痍，谣言却在街巷间蔓延：朝鲜人趁乱发动暴动。恐慌被煽成暴力，大批无辜朝鲜人遭到屠杀。为转移舆论、掩盖惨案，东京检察局局长柳地奉命寻找一桩足够轰动的案件，让公众把愤怒与视线投向新的“敌人”。

朝鲜无政府主义者朴烈和日本女性金子文子，因共同反抗压迫而相知相伴，也因此被卷入当局布下的罗网。柳地将朴烈筹划炸弹的线索不断夸大，企图把两人塑造成威胁国家的危险分子。面对审讯与诱导，朴烈和文子看穿了政府借案掩罪的盘算，没有接受被动安排的罪名，反而主动承认意图刺杀皇太子，把自己推上“大逆罪人”的位置。

他们要求接受死刑，将一场原本用于掩盖真相的政治操弄，转化为公开控诉殖民压迫与国家暴力的法庭对决。审判席前，爱情、信念与民族尊严相互交织；两人明知结局凶险，仍拒绝低头。

全剧以震灾后的屠杀与司法阴谋为起点，呈现朴烈、金子文子以生命争夺发言权的选择。即使身处权力设下的牢笼，他们仍以不屈的意志，让被掩埋的真相发出回响。

26008861.title: WIDERSTAND
26008861.official_plot: 1938년 독일, 야심찬 17살 매그너스는 최고의 펜싱 선수가 되기 위해 가장 친한 친구 아벨과 함께 독일의 엘리트 스포츠 학교에 입학하지만, 학교에 대한 뜻밖의 진실을 알게 된다. 매그너스와 아벨은 펜싱부 친구들과 함께 학교의 비밀을 파헤치고 알리기 시작하면서 그들만의 저항 활동을 시작한다. 한편, 매그너스는 학교의 최고 책임자인 클레어 단장의 관심과 인정을 받으면서 흔들리기 시작하는데....
checklist: 劇名【Widerstand】是德文『抵抗』,也專指納粹德國內部反希特勒的抵抗運動 —— 這是韓國原創劇,不是德國作品
時空=【1938 年德國】,場景是【菁英體育學校(아이드 학교)】的【擊劍部】
主角【매그너스 볼커】17 歲,為了成為最強擊劍選手,和最好的朋友【아벨 루터】一起入學
轉折=他們發現學校【意想不到的真相】,和擊劍部朋友一起挖掘並散播,展開自己的抵抗
另一條線:매그너스 因為受到【클레어 단장】的關注與認可而【開始動搖】—— 這是全劇的內在衝突
六個角色的名字與設定要準:매그너스/아벨/프레드릭 칼/하겐 악스만/재스퍼 뮬러 + 단장 라인하르트 클레어
클레어 的背景:【三十多歲、曾是世界級擊劍英雄】,現在是優雅而殘酷的絕對權力者
🚨 官方 SYNOPSIS 到『매그너스 開始動搖』就結束,【沒有】揭露學校的祕密是什麼、也沒寫結局。namu 有雷區揭露了 아벨 的身世與下場,但那是【劇透】,官方刻意不寫
劇中另有一個【只在回憶與提及中出現的角色 라이너】,由飾演 아벨 的演員一人分飾
26008861.note: 劇名依政策保留原文【WIDERSTAND】(官方英文名即德文原字,無中文演出)。⚠ Perplexity 可能把它跟真實的『白玫瑰(Weiße Rose)』抵抗運動或電影《Napola》混寫 —— namu 明說『비슷한 분위기의 작품으로 나폴라(영화)가 있다』,那是【類比】不是原作,不可寫成改編自那部電影。
26008861.en:
Magnus grips his foil with a single-minded dream: to become Germany’s finest fencer. In 1938, when ordinary training halls are abruptly shut down, he and his closest friend, Abel Luther, enter the prestigious Eid Sports School, the only place where they can continue to train. There they meet the formidable senior Frederick Karl and fellow students Hagen Axmann and Jasper Muller, but the school’s promise of athletic excellence quickly gives way to a brutal regimen of obedience, hierarchy, racial doctrine, and military discipline. Questions are forbidden; personal feeling is treated as weakness.

When Abel and Jasper resist, they are confined in an underground room, where they uncover a forbidden radio and a coded message left by Rainer, a gifted former fencing student whose death was dismissed as an accident. Following Rainer’s clues, the boys find documents revealing Eid’s true purpose: it is a disguised elite military academy, grooming students for compulsory service while isolating them from the outside world. Abel, Jasper, Hagen, and Magnus begin to circulate the evidence and broadcast the truth, calling their covert movement Widerstand.

Yet Magnus is drawn toward another path. Reinhardt Clare, the school’s director and a celebrated fencer whom Magnus admires, singles him out for special instruction and offers him status, victory, and power. As Magnus rises within the school, Clare orders him to identify the rebels. His fear of helplessness and hunger for recognition estrange him from Abel, just as the group’s resistance becomes more dangerous. Abel’s death forces Magnus to confront what silence, ambition, and obedience have cost. Carrying Abel’s final plea to protect him, Magnus enters a national fencing final that may bring him within reach of Hitler himself, and chooses to turn the weapon meant to win glory into an instrument of defiance.

Widerstand examines the moral price of ambition under authoritarian power, asking whether personal achievement can ever justify complicity. It is also a story of friendship, memory, love, and the resolve to protect others even when resistance demands everything.
26008861.zh:
1938年德國，17歲的馬格努斯為了成為頂尖擊劍選手，與摯友阿貝爾走進艾德菁英體育學校。原以為這裡是通往榮耀的唯一道路，兩人卻很快發現校方以體能、血統與服從篩選學生，將擊劍訓練包裝成效忠國家的教育。

阿貝爾不願接受歧視與高壓管束，因反抗而受罰；馬格努斯則在校內結識哈根、賈斯珀與擊劍隊長弗雷德里克。眾人從被囚禁的地下室裡找到違禁收音機及密碼紙條，循線挖出前輩萊納遺留的機密文件：這所學校並非單純培育運動員，而是為納粹政權挑選、塑造菁英軍人的機構。

少年們決定把真相傳出去，以「Widerstand」之名展開祕密抵抗。然而，校長克萊爾看中馬格努斯的天賦與野心，賦予他接近勝利的機會，也要他找出反抗者。夢寐以求的冠軍、來自權力的肯定，以及朋友們冒險守住的信念，迫使他在服從與良知之間做出選擇。

當劍尖不再只指向競技場上的對手，少年們才明白，真正的勇敢不是取得勝利，而是在恐懼中仍選擇不屈服。這場以青春、友誼與擊劍交織而成的抵抗，追問每個人在時代壓力下願意守住什麼。
26008861.cn:
1938年德国，17岁的马格努斯与挚友阿贝尔因各地体育馆突然关闭，进入艾德精英体育学校，盼能继续练习击剑、成为顶尖选手。校园纪律严酷，学生被反复灌输服从、适应与效忠；阿贝尔寄给父母的信遭审查涂黑，更令两人察觉这里绝非普通学校。

阿贝尔与同学贾斯珀因违抗命令被关进地下室，意外发现收音机和前辈莱纳留下的摩斯密码。他们循线在图书馆找到秘密文件，得知学校实为纳粹政权伪装成体育机构的精英军校，专门训练愿为国家舍弃自我的青年。马格努斯、阿贝尔及弗雷德里克、哈根、贾斯珀决定把真相传给全校，秘密发起“维德斯坦德”抵抗行动。

然而，校长克莱尔看中马格努斯的剑术天赋，许诺荣誉与前途，并要求他找出反抗者。个人梦想、朋友安危与良知彼此拉扯，马格努斯不得不面对最残酷的选择：究竟成为被权力认可的冠军，还是与伙伴一起承担反抗的代价。

剑锋所指的不只是胜负，也是一群少年在恐惧中守住人性与友谊的决心。即使前路可能通向失去，他们仍选择睁开眼睛，让抵抗的讯号继续传递。

26011553.title: Your Letter
26011553.official_plot: 다시 시작된, 우리만의 보물찾기 — 여름 방학이 끝나고 청산고로 전학 온 전학생 '이소리'. 이전 학교에서의 상처로 새로운 환경에서도 적응을 어려워하며 홀로 지내던 어느 날, 책상 아래에 붙어있던 익명의 편지를 발견한다. 편지에는 반 친구들에 대한 사소한 이야기부터, 학교에 숨겨진 비밀 장소까지 다양한 이야기들이 따뜻하고 다정한 문체로 적혀있었다. 편지가 이끄는 대로 따라가던 소리는 까칠한 남학생 '박동순'과 자꾸만 얽히게 되고 점차 학교의 비밀과 숨겨진 관계에 다가가게 되는데... 편지가 이끈 그곳엔 어떤 이야기가 기다리고 있을까?
checklist: 🚨 這是【2026 年 9 月世界首演的全新音樂劇】(26.09.16~11.29 플러스씨어터)—— Perplexity 很可能只知道原作網漫或 2025 動畫電影,寫出來的要當『動畫版』看待並核對
原作是【조현아 的 Naver 網漫】;2025-10 另有動畫電影版。官方說音樂劇【沿用大方向劇情】,但不是動畫的移植
主角【이소리】是暑假結束後轉學到【청산고】的轉學生
她因為【前一所學校留下的傷】而難以適應、獨來獨往
關鍵物件:【貼在課桌下面】的匿名信 —— 不是收到的信、不是信箱裡的信
信的內容:從班上同學的瑣事,到【學校裡隱藏的祕密地點】,筆調溫暖親切
她循著信走,一再和【個性彆扭的男同學 박동순】糾纏在一起
官方收在問句『信引領到的那裡,會有什麼故事在等著?』——【沒有】揭曉寫信人是誰、也沒寫結局
本製作有【일루션(幻術)設計】,是舞台特色
26011553.note: 中文劇名:繁《淵的信件》/簡《渊之信》(先前 P2 已用 LINE WEBTOON 台灣官方與咚漫官方查證,記在 selfcheck_ledger)。⚠ 官方海報上那三個獎是【原作網漫】拿的,不是音樂劇拿的 —— 簡介裡不可寫成本劇獲獎。
26011553.en:
Sori opens the desk drawer in her unfamiliar classroom and finds an unsigned letter waiting inside. Having transferred to Cheongsan High after trying to defend a classmate from bullying at her former school, she carries the hurt of becoming isolated herself. The new school feels no safer: every corridor is strange, every new face difficult to trust, and the memory of what happened makes even ordinary days feel exhausting. Yet the letter speaks with unexpected kindness. It offers a shortcut through the school, observations about teachers and students, and a clue leading to another message.

Intrigued, Sori follows the trail. Each letter directs her to a different corner of the campus and turns the school into a quiet treasure hunt. The unknown writer seems to understand exactly how frightening it is to arrive somewhere new, gently urging Sori to look closer, take another step, and believe that connection may still be possible. While seeking the next clue, she repeatedly encounters Park Dongsun, a classmate whose blunt, prickly manner conceals a considerate nature. Their reluctant encounters become companionship, and Dongsun joins Sori in searching for the letters.

As the pair gathers all ten messages, Sori begins to know the people and places around her rather than seeing them only through the distance created by fear. The hunt draws her toward Jeong Hoyeon, the elusive figure associated with the letters, whose presence gives the mystery an almost dreamlike pull. At the same time, the respectable-looking class president An Seunggyu reveals a more rebellious and unsettling side, complicating the fragile relationships forming around Sori. Following the anonymous voice to its end, Sori confronts the lingering wounds of her past and recognizes the sincere care that has been waiting for her in the present.

At its heart, the musical is about the courage to reopen oneself after cruelty and loneliness. Its letters transform a school into a space of memory, friendship, and recovery, suggesting that small acts of kindness can guide someone back toward trust.
26011553.zh:
暑假剛結束，轉學到青山高中的李素里獨自坐在教室裡，從桌下發現一封沒有署名的信。信中不只寫著對新學校的歡迎，還留下尋找下一封信的線索；原本因過往傷痛而封閉自己的素里，於是踏上宛如尋寶般的校園旅程。

她依照提示走遍屋頂、花圃與少有人知的角落，從字句間認識一群性格鮮明的同學，也逐漸注意到總在附近出現的朴東順。外表冷淡、不善言辭的東順，似乎與神祕寄信人鄭浩然有著難以說明的牽連。兩人一面追查信件下落，一面在相處中卸下戒心；素里久未觸碰的友誼與信任，也被一封封溫柔的文字重新喚醒。

然而，校園表面的平靜下藏著成績、霸凌與背叛造成的裂痕。班長安勝奎看似循規蹈矩，卻以另一副面貌操弄同儕關係；東順與浩然各自背負的祕密，也讓信件所指向的真相愈發沉重。當過去的事件被揭開，素里不得不面對自己曾經逃避的恐懼，並思考該如何對待受傷的人與受傷的自己。

最後，這場追尋不只是找出寫信的人，更讓素里明白：真心或許無法立刻撫平傷口，卻能使人不再孤單地往前走。那些被藏起來的心意，終於成為連結彼此、走向和解的答案。
26011553.cn:
暑假结束后，转学生李素丽独自走进青山高中的教室，在自己的课桌抽屉里发现一封没有署名的信。信中既有对校园角落的温柔提示，也留下寻找下一封信的谜题；曾在原学校受过伤、习惯与人保持距离的她，还是被这份突如其来的善意牵动，循着线索开始了一场小小的寻宝。

寻找途中，素丽屡次遇见箭术部男生朴东顺。起初两人彼此别扭，却因共同追查信件逐渐结伴：他们穿过熟悉又陌生的校园，拼凑寄信人郑浩然留下的痕迹。每一封信都像通往过去的一扇门，既引出同学间未说出口的心事，也让素丽不得不重新面对自己曾遭受排挤时的恐惧与愧疚。

随着线索接近终点，安承奎带来的敌意和校园中的流言，使这场寻信之旅蒙上阴影。素丽在东顺及朋友们的陪伴下，终于明白，信件并非只为揭开一个人的秘密，而是在邀请每个曾经孤单的人说出真心、伸出援手。

当最后的谜底揭开，素丽也不再把自己困在往日的伤口里。那些由纸页串起的相遇，让陌生的校园有了可以停留的温度；她学会相信他人的善意，也有勇气把自己的心意传递出去。

26011453.title: M. Butterfly
26011453.official_plot: "오늘 밤, 이 이야기를 다시 시작해" 1960년대 중국 베이징. 프랑스 영사관 직원 '르네 갈리마르'는 오페라 <나비부인>을 보고 우아하고 매혹적인 '송 릴링'에게 단숨에 사로잡힌다. 비밀스러운 만남을 시작한 두 사람. 송은 르네가 꿈꾸던 완벽한 사랑이 되어가고 르네는 이전과는 달라진 자신의 모습을 발견한다. 급변하는 정치 상황 속에 프랑스로 돌아간 르네. 8년 후, 자신이 누리던 모든 것을 버리고 송과의 사랑을 선택한다. 그러던 어느 날, 국가 기밀 누설 혐의로 법정에 선 르네는 자신이 믿어온 사랑의 진실과 마주하고, 완벽했던 그의 세계는 무너지기 시작한다.
checklist: 🚨 這是【全世界第一個音樂劇版】(2026 韓國首演),原作是黃哲倫 1988 年的【話劇】—— 不可寫成百老匯音樂劇,也不可寫成普契尼歌劇《蝴蝶夫人》
時空=【1960 年代中國北京】;르네 갈리마르 是【法國領事館職員/外交官】
他是【看了歌劇《蝴蝶夫人》】之後被【송 릴링】迷住的
송 릴링 的身分:【中國京劇演員】,是르네夢想中的完美愛人、也是隱藏真相的人
時間結構:政局劇變後르네【回到法國】→【八年後】拋下一切選擇與송的愛情
崩塌的觸發點=【以洩漏國家機密罪名出庭受審】
🚨【핑커튼 Pinkerton 是本劇新增的角色】—— 原作話劇沒有。他是《蝴蝶夫人》裡的人物,在本劇是르네的另一個自我
아녜스(妻子)與 친(中共黨員、송的革命同志、主導文化大革命)是【一人分飾兩角】
본작 結合了【《蝴蝶夫人》的劇中劇】與【中國民間傳說「蝴蝶戀人」(梁祝)】兩層互文
官方文本收在『完美的世界開始崩塌』——【沒有】明寫송的真實身分是什麼
26011453.note: 中文劇名【蝴蝶君】(繁簡同名),依據中文維基對原作話劇的定名。⚠ 三個混淆風險:①與普契尼歌劇《蝴蝶夫人》混;②與 1993 年柯能堡電影《M. Butterfly》混(那是電影不是本劇);③把原作話劇的情節當成本劇 —— 本劇加了 핑커튼、加了梁祝互文、把政治衝突改用音樂語言表現。
26011453.en:
René Gallimard sits in a French prison and summons the story that he has spent years reshaping into the romance of his dreams. In 1960s Beijing, the reserved French consular employee sees Song Liling perform the dying heroine of Madama Butterfly and is captivated by Song's poise, beauty, and apparent vulnerability. Song challenges René's ideas about East and West, yet also seems to offer him the adoration and submission he has never believed possible. Their secret meetings draw René out of his timid life and into an intoxicating private world in which he can imagine himself powerful, desired, and indispensable.

As political tensions deepen, René is forced to leave Beijing with his wife, Helga. Distance does not dissolve his attachment to Song. Eight years later, he abandons the security of his former life and chooses Song again, unaware of the calculations beneath their reunion. Song returns to France and steers René toward access to confidential diplomatic material. René, increasingly devoted to the fantasy that Song embodies, passes on information while refusing every doubt that might shatter the identity he has made for himself.

The affair finally becomes a criminal case. Accused of revealing state secrets, René is compelled to confront facts he has evaded: Song has concealed a life, a body, and a political purpose from him. Song's revelation does not merely expose deception; it destroys René's cherished conviction that he was the author, conqueror, and hero of their love. In prison, reality and performance collapse into one another as René clings to the image of his perfect Butterfly even after it can no longer survive.
26011453.zh:
1960年代的北京，法國駐華使館職員雷內．伽利馬爾在一場外交官邸晚宴裡，看見京劇演員宋麗玲演唱《蝴蝶夫人》中巧巧桑自盡的一幕，立刻為其柔美而神祕的姿態傾倒。宋麗玲善解人意、看似羞怯順從，恰好契合伽利馬爾對「東方女性」的浪漫想像；他在這段祕密戀情中，彷彿也找回一直欠缺的自信與男性權威。

伽利馬爾已有妻子，卻愈來愈無法割捨宋麗玲，甚至為她改變人生選擇。兩人的關係歷經政治局勢翻轉與長年分離，宋麗玲仍帶著一名孩子重返他的生命。伽利馬爾為了守護這段愛情，逐漸被推向替對方傳遞國家機密的危險邊緣，最終在法國法庭上，與一樁震驚社會的間諜案一同曝光。這個2026年韓國音樂劇版以音樂劇形式重新編織這段多重視角的愛情與祕密故事。

法庭揭露的真相，徹底粉碎伽利馬爾長年珍視的愛人形象：宋麗玲不僅是受命接近他的間諜，性別身分也與他所相信的截然不同。即使真相近在眼前，伽利馬爾仍執意留在自己塑造的「蝴蝶夫人」幻夢裡；當愛、慾望、權力與西方凝視交纏成無法逃避的審判，他終於必須面對自己究竟愛的是宋麗玲，還是那個由偏見和渴望構成的幻象。
26011453.cn:
20世纪60年代的北京，法国驻华使馆职员勒内·伽利玛在一场演出中看见京剧演员宋丽玲饰演《蝴蝶夫人》中的巧巧桑，立刻被那份矜持、优雅与哀婉打动。性格怯懦、在情感中屡受挫折的他，将宋视为理想中的东方女性；宋则以含蓄、顺从又难以接近的姿态，慢慢引诱他走入一段隐秘关系。勒内在这段爱情里获得久违的自信，甚至沉迷于被爱与掌控的幻觉。
政治局势骤变，勒内被调回法国，却始终无法忘记宋丽玲。多年后，他不惜放弃婚姻与原有生活，再度选择与宋相守。宋借助这份近乎盲目的信任，不断接近勒内掌握的机密；勒内也在爱情、欲望和自我想象的驱使下，一步步越过底线。直到泄密案曝光，他才被推上法庭，并被迫面对自己长期回避的真相：宋丽玲并非他幻想中的“蝴蝶夫人”，而且始终另有身份与目的。
真相击碎的不只是恋情，更是勒内赖以维系自尊的幻梦。他终于明白，自己所爱的或许从来不是眼前的人，而是亲手塑造出的“蝴蝶夫人”。在囚禁与回忆之间，他反而成为那个为爱情殉身的“蝴蝶”。

26010086.title: SOCRATES PARADOX
26010086.official_plot: 소크라테스는 델포이 신전에서 "가장 지혜로운 자는 소크라테스다"라는 신탁을 전해 듣게 되어, 이것이 무슨 뜻인지 알기 위해 여러 현자들을 찾아다녔지만, 결국 지혜로운 자들을 찾지 못하고 '자신이 무지하다는 것을 안다고 말하는 것이 진정 지혜로운 자임'을 깨닫게 된다. 그 후 소크라테스는 아테네 거리에서 만나는 사람들과 철학적 대화를 나누며 오류와 모순을 지적하며 스스로 무지를 깨닫게 해주고, 또한 신의 소명에 따라 사람들의 잘못된 가치관과 욕망을 비판하면서 스스로 '인간 양심의 등에'가 되어 아테네를 변화시키려고 한다. 그러나 권력자들은 청년 시인 멜레토스를 전면에 내세워서 '소크라테스는 나라가 믿는 신을 믿지 않고, 청년들을 타락시켰다'는 이유로 고발하게 된다. 아테네 법정에 나온 소크라테스는 전부터 자신을 고발했던 사람들과 현재 자신을 고발한 멜레토스를 향해서 스스로 변론을 하게 된다. 그는 500명의 배심원들 앞에서 고발 내용의 진위를 가리며 멜레토스와 열띤 심리를 벌이면서 유리한 변론을 하지만, 결국 유죄판결을 받게 되고, 심지어 사형당할 위기에 빠지게 된다. 그러나 소크라테스는 살려 달라고 애원하지 않고 자신의 신념을 굽히지 않는다.
checklist: 🚨 體裁是【饒舌音樂劇(랩 뮤지컬)】—— 黑人音樂×音樂劇,強烈節拍與饒舌。這是本劇的第一識別特徵,簡介不寫等於沒寫
🚨 全劇【只有三種角色】:소크라테스、멜레토스、코러스。不可寫出柏拉圖、色諾芬、克里同、贊西佩等原本歷史上的人
起點=【德爾菲神諭】說『最有智慧的人是蘇格拉底』,他為了弄懂而遍訪賢者
他得到的結論:【承認自己無知才是真正的智者】
他在雅典街頭與人哲學對話、指出謬誤與矛盾,自居為【人類良心的牛虻(등에)】
指控他的是掌權者推到前面的【青年詩人 멜레토스】
罪名兩條:【不信城邦所信的神】+【敗壞青年】
審判細節:【500 名陪審員】面前自我辯護、與 멜레토스 激烈交鋒,【最後仍被判有罪、面臨死刑】
結尾:他【不求饒】,不屈其信念 —— 官方到此為止,【沒有】演到飲鴆
演出長度【80 分鐘】;演出中【允許觀眾出聲應和】
26010086.note: 劇名依政策保留原文【SOCRATES PARADOX】(組成詞雖都有標準中譯、『蘇格拉底悖論』也是既有哲學術語,但劇名層級無官方中文依據)。⚠ Perplexity 最可能的錯誤是寫成一般的蘇格拉底傳記劇、加入柏拉圖等人,或寫到飲毒酒而死 —— 官方文本止於他不屈服。
26010086.en:
Socrates steps before the Athenian court as Meletos, a young poet, accuses him of rejecting the city’s gods and corrupting its youth. The charge gives public shape to years of resentment. Ever since the oracle at the temple of Delphoi declared that no one was wiser than Socrates, he has searched among politicians, poets, craftsmen, and supposed experts for the meaning of that pronouncement. Each encounter has led him to the same discovery: people who claim certainty often cannot defend what they say they know. Socrates concludes that his only wisdom lies in recognising the limits of his own knowledge.

Carrying that conviction into the streets of Athina, he questions strangers, exposes contradictions in accepted beliefs, and challenges the ambition, vanity, and complacency of those with influence. To some young people, his relentless questioning opens a path toward independent thought. To others, especially the powerful citizens unsettled by his influence, he becomes an intolerable provocation. Meletos is brought forward as the voice of this opposition, insisting that Socrates has endangered the city by leading its young away from tradition and reverence.

Before a jury of five hundred, Socrates conducts his own defence. He tests Meletos’s allegations point by point, forcing his accuser to confront the inconsistencies in his case. Rather than plead for pity or flatter the court, Socrates argues that his questioning is a duty entrusted to him, a necessary sting against a society too willing to mistake reputation for truth. His defence may reveal the weakness of the accusations, but it cannot overcome the hostility gathered against him.

The court finds Socrates guilty and places him under the shadow of death. Even then, he refuses to bargain away his principles or beg to be spared. Facing the sentence with unwavering composure, he chooses fidelity to truth over a life purchased through silence.

The musical centres on the paradox that genuine wisdom begins with knowing one’s ignorance. It pits individual conscience against public fear, asking whether a society can endure the voice that refuses easy answers.
26010086.zh:
雅典的法庭上，年邁的哲學家蘇格拉底獨自站在五百名陪審員面前，迎戰年輕詩人梅勒托斯提出的控訴。梅勒托斯指稱他不敬城邦諸神、另立新神，更以詭辯毒害青年；蘇格拉底卻不急於替自己求情，而是以連串追問拆解對方的指控，逼使眾人重新檢視何謂正義、智慧與真實。

審判之際，他回望自己的人生：德爾斐神諭曾宣告他是最有智慧的人，他為理解其意義，走訪自認博學的政治家、詩人與工匠，發現許多人其實不懂，卻深信自己無所不知。蘇格拉底因而明白，真正的智慧不在於佔有答案，而在於承認自身的無知。他走上街頭與人辯證，揭露虛榮、權力與慾望下的矛盾，也因此招致城邦權貴的敵視。

面對梅勒托斯與舊日敵人的圍攻，蘇格拉底雖在辯論中佔得上風，仍被判決有罪，並面臨死刑。他拒絕以討好陪審團或放棄信念換取生路，堅持人不該因恐懼而背離真理與良知。

最終，蘇格拉底以平靜接受死亡，將審判轉化為對每個人的叩問：人是否真知道自己所相信的事？當多數人的裁決與內心的真實相衝突，又該如何選擇？
26010086.cn:
雅典的法庭上，年迈的哲学家苏格拉底独自站在五百名陪审员面前，迎接青年诗人梅勒托斯咄咄逼人的指控。梅勒托斯宣称，苏格拉底不敬城邦诸神，又以诡辩蛊惑青年、败坏风气；这场审判不仅关乎一名老人是否有罪，也汇集了城邦长期积累的敌意。

回望过往，苏格拉底曾从德尔斐神谕得知自己被称为“最有智慧的人”。为弄清神意，他走访自诩聪明的政治家、诗人和工匠，在不断追问中发现：许多人以为自己无所不知，真正的智慧却是承认自身无知。此后，他穿行于雅典街头，同人们辩论正义、信仰、欲望与德行，揭露言辞中的矛盾，试图唤醒被成见支配的心灵。

然而，这种不肯附和权威的追问触怒了掌权者。梅勒托斯被推到前台，成为控方的声音。面对“另立新神”和“腐蚀青年”的罪名，苏格拉底拒绝讨好陪审团，也不以哀求换取宽恕；他反过来质询控方，追究指控中的漏洞，并坚持自己只是奉神之命提醒雅典人反省自身。

最终，判决仍然落下，死刑的阴影逼近。苏格拉底宁愿承担代价，也不愿背弃真理与良知。他的失败因而成为另一种胜利：当众人以沉默求生时，仍有人选择为思考与信念付出生命。

26011560.title: Turbulent age
26011560.official_plot: "같은 곳을 바라보던 서로가 칼이 된 밤" 고려의 운명이 다하고 새로운 시대가 태동하던 난세. 혼란한 시대를 끝내고 새로운 나라를 세우기 위해 뜻을 함께한 두 사람이 있었다. 이상을 현실로 만들고자 했던 정도전, 그리고 현실을 움직이는 힘이 곧 이상을 완성한다고 믿었던 이방원. 생각은 달랐지만 두 사람은 서로를 스승과 제자로 삼아 조선을 건국한다. 그러나 두 사람의 신념은 점점 충돌하고, 함께 나라를 세운 동지는 서로를 위협하는 적이 되어간다. 그러던 어느 날, 태조 이성계가 갑작스러운 낙마 사고로 병석에 눕는다. 조선을 떠받치던 거대한 축이 흔들리자 정도전이 쌓아 올린 권력의 균형도 흔들리기 시작한다. 이방원을 누구보다 잘 아는 정도전은 이 혼란을 틈타 움직일 그를 경계하(며)…, 개국공신 책봉과 세자 책봉에서 밀려나 오랫동안 몸을 낮추고 있던 이방원에게는 마침내 기다려 온 기회가 찾아온다. 왕이 쓰러진 그 밤, 서로의 수를 누구보다 잘 아는 스승과 제자는 조선의 운명을 건 마지막 승부를 시작한다.
checklist: 🚨【2026 這一輪重新改成兩人劇(2인극)】—— 只有 정도전 與 이방원 兩個角色。四年前的 2022 初演不是。簡介必須寫這一輪
時代=【高麗末到朝鮮開國】的亂世
兩人的差別要寫準:정도전=【想把理想變成現實】;이방원=【相信推動現實的力量才能完成理想】
關係=【師徒(스승과 제자)】,一起開國
轉折點=【太祖李成桂突然墜馬(낙마)臥病】—— 不是病死、不是遇刺
李成桂倒下後,정도전 建立的權力平衡開始動搖
이방원 的處境:【被排除在開國功臣冊封與世子冊封之外】,長期隱忍
高潮=【王倒下的那一夜】,最了解彼此棋路的師徒展開賭上朝鮮命運的最後一局
官方以【棋局(장기판/수)】為全劇比喻,兩人的台詞都用下棋設喻
官方【沒有】演到王子之亂的結果,收在『最後一局開始』
26011560.note: 劇名依政策保留原文【난세】(主標『亂世』是語意試譯無官方依據;副標的 정도전=鄭道傳、이방원=李芳遠有標準中文名,但本表不收副標)。⚠ Perplexity 極可能直接用【第一次王子之亂】的史實把結局寫出來(정도전 被 이방원 誅殺),但官方文本刻意停在對局開始 —— 若寫出結局需標為史實背景而非本劇情節。另外務必避免寫成群戲。
26011560.en:
Across a janggi board on the eve of the First Strife of Princes, Jeong Dojeon and Yi Bangwon sit face to face, their conversation sharpened by the knowledge that neither may survive the coming night. Once bound by trust, they revisit the years in which they stood together amid the collapse of Goryeo, convinced that a ruined age demanded a new political order. Jeong Dojeon, the brilliant scholar and architect of revolution, sees in Yi Seonggye the force capable of overthrowing the old dynasty and founding a country governed through institutions, learned ministers, and a vision of rule for the people. Yi Bangwon, Yi Seonggye's fifth son, becomes Jeong Dojeon's devoted ally and pupil, lending resolve and action to the shared cause.

Their alliance helps bring a new dynasty into being, but victory exposes divisions that revolution had concealed. Jeong Dojeon seeks to curb royal power and secure the succession around a new heir, believing that a stable state must not depend upon the ambitions of a single ruler. Yi Bangwon, passed over in the distribution of honours and excluded from the succession he believes he has earned, comes to regard Jeong Dojeon's plans as both an insult and a threat to his family's future. The mentor who once offered him a path becomes the obstacle he cannot allow to remain.

As Yi Seonggye falls ill, the fragile balance inside the new court collapses. Jeong Dojeon tries to protect the political order he has designed, while Yi Bangwon gathers the will to strike first. Their recollections of shared ideals turn into accusations: each claims to be saving the nation, yet each sees the other's survival as fatal. The night advances toward bloodshed, forcing both men to confront what their revolution has made of them.

The musical examines how companionship can fracture when ideals meet power. It asks whether a nation can truly be built for its people when those who invoke the people are also fighting to determine who will rule.
26011560.zh:
1398年第一次王子之亂前夕，鄭道傳與李芳遠隔著一盤將棋相對而坐，兩人早已把手按在劍柄旁，卻仍不得不回望那段並肩追逐新世代的歲月。高麗末年朝政腐敗、百姓困苦，胸懷改革理想的鄭道傳相信唯有擁立李成桂、推翻舊王朝，才能建立以百姓為本的新國家；年輕的李芳遠則敬重這位才智卓絕的師友，也投身革命，盼能親手終結亂世。

然而朝鮮建國後，原本的同路人開始走向分歧。鄭道傳欲以制度限制王權、扶植世子，使理想中的國家不再由一人意志支配；李芳遠卻屢遭排拒，認定自己為建國立下的功勞與能力都被忽視。他相信亂世未盡，若不能握有足以決斷的權力，國家終將再度傾覆。

李成桂病倒，王位繼承與政權歸屬頓時成為一觸即發的局面。鄭道傳看穿李芳遠的野心，試圖先發制人；李芳遠也決定不再等待，將昔日知己視為阻礙自己生路與國家未來的敵人。棋局未完，兩人的回憶、敬意與怨恨卻已化成無法收回的殺機。

同樣想救國的兩人，終究因對理想與權力的不同信念而決裂。亂世將盡之際，他們也親手斬斷了彼此曾共享的夢想。
26011560.cn:
1398年第一次王子之乱前夜，病中的太祖李成桂未能主持朝局，郑道传与李芳远隔着棋盘相对而坐，刀兵将起，往昔也被重新翻开。高丽末年，朝廷腐败、百姓困苦，胸怀经世理想的郑道传与渴望结束乱世的李芳远因李成桂而相识。二人曾互为知己，携手筹划推翻旧王朝，盼望建立一个让百姓安居的新国家。

新朝建立后，理想的道路却渐渐分岔。郑道传希望以制度约束王权、扶植文治，使国家不再依附某一位强人；李芳远则认为乱世初定，唯有集中权力、以铁腕清除隐患，才能守住来之不易的江山。郑道传在功臣封赏与储君问题上排斥李芳远，也担忧他日后成为威胁；屡受冷落的李芳远则从失意与愤怒中看清，自己若不先出手，便会沦为被除去的人。

回忆与现实交错推进，昔日师友不断追问彼此：究竟谁真正理解百姓，谁又只是借天下之名实现自己的抱负？当李成桂病倒，权力的空隙骤然显现，两人终于无法再以言辞维系同盟。

棋局终有落子，理想也在权谋与恐惧中变形。郑道传和李芳远都想终结乱世，却终究把对方视作必须跨越的最后障碍。

26002729.catalog_group: welcome to the hyunam dong bookshop
26002729.title: Welcome to the Hyunam-Dong Bookshop
26002729.official_plot: 주인공 영주는 어떠한 사건을 계기로 모든 것을 정리하고 조용한 동네 휴남동에서 서점을 오픈한다. 처음에는 아무도 발을 들이지 않았으나, 묘한 휴남동 서점의 분위기에 시간이 지날수록 사람들은 점점 그곳을 방문하게 된다. 영주는 서점 안 작은 카페를 열며 바리스타를 고용하고 점점 자신의 삶에 활기를 찾게 된다. 휴남동 서점에는 단골 손님들도 하나둘씩 늘어나는데... 대부분 힘겨운 고민을 안고 살아가는 이들이지만…
checklist: 主角【영주】因為某件事而【收拾掉一切】,搬到安靜的社區【휴남동】開書店 —— 官方刻意寫『어떠한 사건(某件事)』,【沒有說明】是什麼事,簡介不可自行填
一開始【沒有人上門】,是書店特別的氛圍讓人漸漸走進來
她在書店裡開了【小咖啡館】並【雇用了咖啡師】,生活才漸漸有了生氣
常客一個個增加,【多半是懷著沉重煩惱的人】
咖啡師叫【민준】;另有【승우(知名作家)】、【정서】、【희주】等人物
⚠ 這一檔是【OPEN RUN(不設閉幕日的長期公演)】,2025-03-01 起於 루미나아트홀;首演是 2024-10 CJ아지트 대학로
獲獎歸屬要分清:【2024 日本書店大獎翻譯小說第一名】是【原著小說】拿的;【2024 CJ문화재단 스테이지업 선정작】才是【音樂劇】拿的
26002729.note: 中文劇名:繁《歡迎光臨休南洞書店》(台灣采實文化原著譯本定名,P2 已查證)。⚠ 這齣是療癒系群像劇,Perplexity 很容易改寫成原著小說的完整章節(讀書會、寫作課、영주的離婚、민준的求職挫折等)—— 官方音樂劇文案只到『常客漸漸增加』,更細的情節要另外找音樂劇本身的來源才能寫。
26002729.en:
Yeongju unlocks the door of a small, quiet bookshop in Hyunam-dong after leaving behind the exhaustion and pressure that once ruled her life. At first, she has little purpose beyond opening the shop each morning and closing it each night, but she gradually turns the space into a place where people may linger rather than simply buy books. When she hires Minjun, a young man worn down by repeated attempts to find work, the bookshop gains the warm scent and steady rhythm of a cafe. Minjun has abandoned the race to prove himself through employment, yet serving coffee and listening to visitors slowly teach him that a life need not be exceptional to be worthwhile.

People with private burdens begin to gather there. Jeongseo, hurt by unstable work and unfair treatment, seeks calm through knitting and meditation. Huiju worries over her disengaged teenage son, Mincheol, whose lack of ambition and joy makes both mother and son feel trapped. Asked to visit the shop regularly, Mincheol initially arrives without enthusiasm, but the conversations, books, and unhurried company of Hyunam-dong Bookshop give him room to voice questions he cannot easily ask elsewhere. Sangsu becomes a dependable presence among the regulars, while Jimi, who supplies coffee beans, brings her own troubled domestic life into the circle. Seungwoo, a sharp-tongued writer, enters Yeongju's world as a new connection whose candour challenges her guardedness.

As coffee is poured, books are recommended, and ordinary worries are spoken aloud, the visitors do not find easy solutions. Instead, they learn to pause, hear one another, and take modest but meaningful steps toward lives they can accept as their own.

The musical centers on recovery from burnout, loneliness, and the pressure to measure life by conventional success. It celebrates the quiet power of books, patient listening, chosen community, and the courage to begin again at one's own pace.
26002729.zh:
榮珠在寧靜的休南洞打開新書店的門，決心把過去的人生連同疲憊一併留在身後。經歷難以言說的挫敗後，她辭去原有生活，卻也不知道自己真正想要什麼；空蕩的書架與少得可憐的來客，使她只能日復一日地煮咖啡、整理書本，等待心情慢慢平靜。

直到求職受挫的敏俊前來應徵，成為書店的咖啡師，店內才逐漸有了香氣與人聲。渴望寫作卻屢遭現實磨損的承祐、為家務與親子關係困住的熙珠、習慣在角落編織並沉默觀察眾人的正書等人，也陸續走進這間小店。他們帶著失業、孤獨、失敗與無處安放的焦慮，卻不急著要求彼此給出答案。

在共讀、談話與一杯杯咖啡之間，書店成了能暫停腳步的所在。眾人從旁人的故事裡照見自己，練習承認脆弱，也嘗試不再用單一標準衡量人生；榮珠尤其在與敏俊及常客相處時，重新思考「過得好」究竟是什麼。

休南洞書店沒有立刻替誰解決難題，卻讓每個人找回傾聽自己與走下去的勇氣。當門再度開啟，他們明白人生未必需要唯一正解，只要願意停留、相伴，仍能寫出屬於自己的下一頁。
26002729.cn:
一场变故后，英珠辞去原有的生活，在安静的休南洞开了一家小书店。起初，她无心经营，只是每天准时开门、关门，任由店内的书架与沉默陪伴自己；然而，书店独有的宁静气息渐渐吸引了附近的人们。

英珠在店里开设咖啡角，雇来正在求职与自我怀疑之间徘徊的敏俊做咖啡师。曾在程序员工作中耗尽热情的承宇、因生活压力而来织毛线的贞书、总被母亲催着读书的高中生敏哲，以及爽朗热心的敏哲母亲熙珠，也陆续成了店里的常客。每个人都带着无法轻易向外人诉说的疲惫、焦虑或遗憾，却在咖啡香、书页声和不经意的交谈中，慢慢显露真实的心事。

书店不再只是买书的地方。英珠尝试写下店铺日常、举办读书会和写作课，让原本互不相识的人分享故事，也让彼此的沉默有了被理解的余地。敏俊重新看见自己的价值，承宇开始整理被工作吞没的人生，其他人也在微小的陪伴中学习与困境共处。

当人们一次次推开那扇门，休南洞书店逐渐成为可以暂歇、可以坦白、也可以重新出发的角落。英珠终于明白，人生不必急着证明什么；能够按自己的步调生活，并与他人温柔相连，已是珍贵的答案。

26011932.title: 모노뮤지컬 His-Story
26011932.official_plot: 예수라는 인물을 찾아가는 다양한 이야기를 1인극 형식의 뮤지컬로 제작한 공연. 배우는 극 중 뮤지컬 작가 겸 작곡가로 등장한다. 어느날 목사로부터 예수에 대한 새로운 형식의 공연을 의뢰 받고 예수가 직접 등장하지 않는, 그리고 모노 드라마 형식의 뮤지컬을 구상하고 대본과 곡을 만들고, 자신이 직접 실연을 하면서 작품을 수정하는 과정을 보여주는 모노뮤지컬. 배우는 작가의 역할을 포함해서 1인 10역의 다양한 역할을 수행하면서 예수가 등장하지 않는 예수의 이야기를 뮤지컬로 공연한다.
checklist: 體裁=【모노뮤지컬(單人音樂劇)】,只有一位演員,【一人分飾十角】
劇中角色是一位【音樂劇編劇兼作曲家】—— 不是耶穌、不是門徒
情節=他受【牧師】委託創作一齣關於耶穌的新形式演出
🚨 他設計的是【耶穌本人不出場】的獨角戲音樂劇 —— 這是全劇最核心的設定
舞台上呈現的是他【寫劇本、寫曲、自己試演、邊演邊改】的過程(後設結構)
劇名 His-Story 是【His + Story ↔ History】的雙關,中文保不住 → 保留原文
副標是【예수(耶穌)】
26011932.note: 劇名依政策保留原文。⚠ Perplexity 極可能寫成耶穌生平音樂劇(類似《萬世巨星》)—— 官方明說耶穌【不出場】,寫的是創作者本人的創作過程。
26011932.en:
A phone rings just as Jesus cries out from the cross, wrenching the audience away from the familiar image of crucifixion and into the cluttered room of a musical writer. Commissioned by a pastor to create a work about Jesus, the writer struggles to find a form that will not merely repeat a story everyone thinks they already know. He begins to test an idea: Jesus will not speak for himself alone. Instead, the people who encountered him will step forward, each revealing a different face of the man at the centre of their lives.

As the writer imagines and performs the parts, the story moves from prophecy and birth towards judgment and execution. Yosep confronts the mystery of a child whose arrival upends ordinary expectations. Dongbang Baksas proclaim the birth of the Messiah, while a Rabbi debates the twelve-year-old Jesus and is unsettled by the boy's insight. Sebang Yohan recognises the promised figure in Jesus, but the Devil challenges him in the wilderness, pressing him to turn spiritual calling into power and spectacle.

The writer shifts rapidly among witnesses, opponents, followers, and the crowd. Garot Yuda's disillusionment hardens into betrayal. Herod ridicules the prisoner brought before him, and Pilate weighs political expediency against conscience. Barabbas becomes part of the cruel choice made by a crowd that demands release for one prisoner and death for another. Through these conflicting voices, Jesus emerges not as a distant icon but as someone who provokes faith, fear, hope, anger, and misunderstanding. The journey returns at last to Golgotha, where the cross completes the story the writer has been trying to understand.

The musical considers how a life can be known through the testimonies of those who loved, opposed, used, doubted, or abandoned its subject. It centres on belief, betrayal, moral responsibility, and the unsettling force of a figure whose meaning remains contested by every witness.
26011932.zh:
一名正在撰寫音樂劇劇本的作家，接下牧師委託，要把耶穌的人生搬上舞臺；面對早已被無數人講述過的故事，他苦思如何找到新鮮而真實的切入點。於是，他不讓耶穌親自現身自述，而是走近那些曾與祂擦肩、相遇，甚至傷害過祂的人。

懷抱耶穌的母親回望那個非比尋常的誕生；漁夫憶起自己被呼喚離開船隻、踏上未知道路的瞬間；痲瘋病人、罪人與受苦者，則在被接納與醫治後，重新認識自身的價值。有人因祂的話語燃起盼望，有人因祂觸犯既有秩序而恐懼、憤怒；跟隨者的忠誠也在壓力下動搖，背叛與否認接連逼近。

當審判、鞭打與十字架的陰影降臨，作家和角色一同追問：一個人若選擇愛到底，究竟要付出什麼代價？死亡並未讓見證停止，反而使那些破碎、逃離或曾經沉默的人，開始重新理解祂留下的話語與行動。

全劇以多個旁觀者的第一人稱串連耶穌從誕生、傳道到受難與復活的旅程，讓宏大的信仰故事落在一張張具體的人臉上。每段證言都像一面鏡子，映照人如何在懷疑、恐懼與愛之間作出選擇。
26011932.cn:
巴拉巴原本等候处刑，却因拿撒勒人耶稣被押上刑场而意外获释。这个陌生人的名字从此萦绕在他心头：耶稣究竟是谁，为什么有人拥戴他为救主，也有人急欲将他置于死地？在追问中，巴拉巴仿佛聆听到一连串来自不同时空的证言。先知以赛亚预言救赎的来临，东方博士循星而至；施洗约翰宣告道路已被预备，拉比则从律法与教义审视这位颠覆常规的行者。

耶稣医治病患、亲近被厌弃者、宣讲饶恕与天国，却也触动既有的秩序。试探者诱使人怀疑他的使命，犹大在信赖与失望间摇摆，希律将他视作可供取乐的奇人，彼拉多则在权力、民意与良知之间迟疑。不同人物各自陈述所见的耶稣，既折射出恐惧、欲望和偏见，也显露被其言行改变的可能。

当审判最终走向十字架，巴拉巴不得不面对一个无法回避的事实：自己获得的生机，正建立在耶稣的死亡之上。死亡并未让追问终止，反而使“他是谁”的问题变得更加迫切。

全剧以众人的目光拼合耶稣从降生、传道到受难的生命轨迹。它将答案留给观众：在每一次见证与沉默之间，重新辨认牺牲、救赎与人的选择。

26011647.title: 그날들
26011647.official_plot: 1992년, 청와대 경호실. '그날'은 그렇게 시작되었다. 청와대 경호실. 원칙주의자 '정학'과 자유분방한 동기 '무영'. 최고의 인재로 꼽히던 두 사람은 라이벌이자 둘도 없는 친구로 우정을 쌓아간다. 한중 수교를 앞두고 그들에게 내려진 극비 임무. "신분을 알 수 없는 '그녀'를 보호하라." 하지만 수교 당일, '그녀'와 '무영'이 흔적도 없이 사라진다. 2022년, 다시 시작된 '그날'의 데자뷰. 한중 수교 30주년 기념행사가 한창인 청와대. 경호부장이 된 '정학'에게 30년 전과 똑같은 실종 소식이 전해진다. 대통령의 딸 '하나'와 수행 경호원 '대식'이 자취를 감춘 것. 마치 30년 전, '그날'처럼. 사라진 이들의 행방을 쫓는 '정학' 앞에, 오래전 묻어두었던 '무영'과 '그녀'의 흔적들이 하나둘씩 발견되기 시작하는데...
checklist: 體裁=【김광석(金光石)歌曲的點唱機音樂劇】—— 不是原創音樂,是把他的歌重新編曲
場景=【青瓦臺警護室(總統維安處)】,雙時間線交錯
過去線=【1992 年】,韓中建交前夕;兩位同期警衛【정학(原則主義者)】與【무영(自由不羈)】,既是對手也是摯友
極機密任務原文:『신분을 알 수 없는 「그녀」를 보호하라(保護一個身分不明的「她」)』
『她』的身分是【韓中建交的口譯員】;她知道建交儀式(1992-08-24)的祕密
過去線的事件:【建交當天,「她」與「무영」一起消失得無影無蹤】
現在線=【2022 年】(韓中建交【30 週年】紀念活動);2026 這一版設定為 30 週年,舊版是 20 週年
現在線的事件:已升任警護部長的정학接到【和 30 年前一模一樣的失蹤消息】——【總統的女兒 하나】與隨扈【대식】不見了
🚨【那個祕密到全劇結束都沒有揭曉】(namu 明載)—— 簡介不可自行編出祕密內容
무영 的漢字是【霧影】(霧中之影),名字本身就是設定
26011647.note: 劇名依 P2 titles 決議暫保留原文(『那些日子』為語意試譯)。⚠ Perplexity 可能把它跟另一齣김광석 주크박스 뮤지컬《바람이 불어오는 곳》混,或把『祕密』編出來。我們資料庫這一筆是【이천 巡演場】,但劇情同全國巡演版。
26011647.en:
Jeonghak receives an urgent report during a commemorative event at Cheong Wa Dae: Hana, the President's daughter, has vanished together with her assigned guard, Daesik. Now head of security, Jeonghak recognizes an alarming pattern in their disappearance, one that leads him back to 1992 and the unresolved day that reshaped his life.

Twenty years earlier, Jeonghak entered Cheong Wa Dae as an exemplary but rigid young guard. There he met Muyoung, a gifted fellow recruit whose easy wit and free-spirited manner clashed with Jeonghak's discipline. Competition gradually becomes friendship as the two prove themselves among the strongest of their class. On the eve of a major diplomatic occasion, they receive their first sensitive assignment: protect Geunyeo, a woman whose identity is concealed even from the guards charged with watching her. Confined and isolated, Geunyeo longs for a life beyond the walls around her. As Jeonghak and Muyoung come to know her, their duty becomes entangled with affection, pity, suspicion, and an increasingly dangerous awareness that powerful people may want her silenced.

Then Geunyeo disappears. Muyoung disappears with her, and Jeonghak is left behind to bear the consequences of an event no official account will fully explain. In 2012, Hana and Daesik's flight revives the old mystery. Jeonghak follows a trail through places, objects, and memories that connect the missing pair to Muyoung and Geunyeo. As the past and present mirror one another, the investigation forces him to confront what he believed about loyalty, abandonment, and the choices made in the name of protection. The search for Hana and Daesik becomes a chance to uncover the truth buried for two decades.

The musical centers on friendship tested by duty, love constrained by power, and the lasting cost of secrets. Its parallel disappearances suggest that memory cannot be contained indefinitely: unless the past is faced honestly, its unfinished choices echo into another generation.
26011647.zh:
1992年，青瓦臺警護室的新進警衛車正學與姜無影接下祕密任務：保護一名身分不明、掌握中韓建交內情的女翻譯。嚴守紀律的正學與瀟灑不羈的無影是同期競爭對手，也是能託付性命的摯友；兩人在護衛期間逐漸察覺，這項任務表面是保護，實則暗藏監控與滅口的危機。無影因憐惜「她」的處境而與她相戀，當上級的命令與守護生命的信念相衝突時，他選擇帶她逃離。正學卻被迫面對好友與目標人物同時失蹤的局面，在組織壓力與誤解下，將無影視為背叛者，兩人的友誼從此留下無法癒合的裂縫。

二十年後，已成為警護處長的正學，正逢中韓建交紀念活動籌備之際，得知總統之女高荷娜與隨扈金大植雙雙失蹤。眼前事件與往日如出一轍，使他重新追查那段被掩埋的往事；隨著線索交錯，他也逐步看見無影當年未曾說出口的真心與犧牲。

當真相終於浮現，正學才明白，無影並未背棄朋友與職責，而是以自己的方式守住了所愛之人。那些無法重返的日子，遂成為關於友誼、愛情、選擇與原諒的深刻記憶。
26011647.cn:
1992年，青瓦台警卫郑学与性格不羁的同期武英并肩受训，两人既较劲又惺惺相惜，迅速成为能托付后背的伙伴。中韩建交前夕，他们接到首项高度机密的任务：看护一名身份不能公开的年轻女子。她被安置在戒备森严的住所，孤独而敏感；武英逐渐被她的自由与坚韧打动，郑学也在职责与良知之间感到不安。

然而，一则预先写下死亡日期的消息让他们意识到，这名女子或许正被卷入不可言说的阴谋。面对上级的命令、外界的追捕和彼此不同的判断，三人决定冒险逃离。混乱中，女子与武英一同失踪，郑学则背负污名，二十年前的真相被彻底掩埋。

2012年，中韩建交二十周年纪念活动临近，已任警卫部长的郑学再度遭遇相似危机：总统之女荷娜与随行警卫大植突然失踪。追查两人的去向时，他不断发现旧案留下的痕迹，也重新面对当年未能说出口的选择与歉疚。

两起跨越二十年的失踪案彼此映照，揭开权力、牺牲、友情与爱情交织的秘密。最终，尘封的往事让幸存者理解：有些人虽被岁月带走，留下的信念与思念却始终指引后来者。

26003258.title: 김종욱 찾기
26003258.official_plot: [SYNOPSIS 以對白圖呈現] "김종욱이요." / "이름은요?" "나이는요?" "전화번..?" "사는 곳은?" — "몰라요. 몰라요. 몰라요." 김.종.욱 이름 석 자 빼곤 아는 게 없다! '첫사랑 찾기 주식회사' 첫 고객의 '첫사랑'을 찾아야 한다. 과연, 그 여자는 첫사랑 김종욱을 만날 수 있을까?
checklist: 🚨【三人劇】:그 남자(兼演김종욱)、그 여자、멀티맨(一人分飾多角)—— 不可寫成群戲
核心設定:女主角對初戀【只記得「金鐘旭」這三個字】,名字以外一無所知(年齡、電話、住處全都『몰라요』)
推動劇情的是【「尋找初戀股份有限公司」】,女主角是它的【第一位客戶】
官方以問句收尾『那個女子能見到初戀金鐘旭嗎?』——【沒有】寫結局
類型=【大學路代表性浪漫喜劇音樂劇】,2006 年首演至今,累計【155 萬觀眾】
編導是【장유정】(同時也是《그날들》的編導)
26003258.note: 🚨 中文劇名【尋找金鐘旭】(繁)—— v2.111.1 已修正。原本錯用《尋找完美先生》,那是【2010 年同名電影】的台灣片名,不是這齣音樂劇的。⚠ Perplexity 極可能寫成電影版劇情(印度旅行相遇等)——電影與音樂劇同源但不同版本,寫的必須是舞台版。
26003258.en:
After losing his job and his girlfriend in quick succession, Geu Namja hears a stranger speak wistfully of finding a first love and turns the idea into a business. He opens Cheotsarang Chatgi Jusik Hoesa, a tiny agency devoted to locating the people clients have never quite forgotten. His first customer is Geu Yeoja, who arrives under pressure from her father to settle down and marry, yet remains unable to let go of the man she met years earlier while travelling in India: Gim Jonguk.

Her information is almost useless. She knows only his name, remembers a brief journey and a promise to meet again in Seoul, and carries the idealised memory of a young man who seemed to embody the future she wanted. Nevertheless, Geu Namja approaches the assignment with dogged professionalism. He tracks down one Gim Jonguk after another, arranging interviews that lead to comic disappointments, awkward misunderstandings, and increasingly improbable possibilities. Geu Yeoja repeatedly finds reasons that each candidate cannot be the one she remembers, suggesting that the search is less about identification than about protecting a cherished past from reality.

As the investigation takes them through encounters with many people and places, Geu Namja and Geu Yeoja spend more time together. His practical persistence clashes with her romantic hesitation, but their bickering becomes companionship. Geu Namja gradually recognises that his feelings for her have moved beyond client and investigator; Geu Yeoja, meanwhile, must confront why she has held onto Gim Jonguk for so long and whether she truly wishes to find him. When evidence finally brings the elusive first love within reach, the outcome forces her to distinguish memory from love and to choose how she will live in the present.

The musical considers first love as both a private dream and a refuge from adult uncertainty. It celebrates the courage to face unfinished feelings, while suggesting that genuine connection may appear not in an idealised past but in the person who shares the difficult search.
26003258.zh:
在「尋找初戀股份有限公司」狹小的辦公室裡，剛遭公司裁員、又被女友甩掉的男人，認真掛起替人尋找初戀的招牌；他的第一位客戶，是被父親催婚而來的女人。她手上只有一個名字——金鍾旭——以及七年前在印度旅行時邂逅的記憶：二十二歲的她相信命運，在異國遇見那名令她怦然心動的男子，兩人約好一個月後回到韓國重逢，卻從此失去聯絡。如今，這段未竟的約定成了她遲遲無法前進的心結。

男人依循零碎線索展開尋人行動，兩人穿梭於各種可疑的「金鍾旭」之間，荒謬烏龍接連發生。一路鬥嘴、互相拆臺的過程中，原本拘謹又一板一眼的男人，逐漸看見女人逞強外表下對愛情的膽怯；女人也發現，這位看似笨拙的尋人專家總在她最狼狽時伸手相助。隨著真正的金鍾旭愈來愈接近，她卻開始逃避答案，因為她珍惜的或許不是那個人，而是從未被現實碰觸過的初戀想像。

最終，女人鼓起勇氣面對久別的初戀，為七年前的遺憾畫下句點。當舊日幻影終於退場，她才明白，真正值得把握的緣分，早已在這段尋人旅程中悄悄來到身邊。
26003258.cn:
首尔一家“初恋寻人公司”里，刚创业的男人迎来第一位委托人。她在父亲催婚和现实压力下，决定寻找七年前在印度旅行时邂逅的初恋金钟旭；可除名字外，她几乎说不出任何线索。男人原本循规蹈矩，失业又失恋后才靠替人寻找初恋维生；女人看似爽朗果断，心里却始终把那段相遇当作命中注定。两人从她模糊的回忆出发，追查旧住址、登报、广播求助，也接连遇见许多个同名的“金钟旭”。荒唐的寻人过程让他们不断斗嘴，也迫使彼此卸下防备。

旅途中，男人一次次依据零碎细节推断目标的身份，女人却总能否认，并在真相近在眼前时慌忙退缩。原来，她并非全无资料，而是不愿真正面对那位初恋：她害怕重逢会毁掉记忆中最完美的青春幻象。与此同时，男人发现自己在帮她寻找别人时，早已把她放进了心里。

当被珍藏多年的证件与日记揭开隐瞒，女人终于明白，自己执着寻找的或许并不是某个名字，而是曾经敢于相信爱情的自己。她选择与过去告别，也让眼前这段意外开始的同行有了新的可能。寻找金钟旭的旅程，最终成了一场寻找真心、接受成长的浪漫冒险。

26008450.title: 빨래
26008450.official_plot: 서울살이 5년 차, 나영. 작가의 꿈을 안고 상경했지만 막막한 현실에 자신의 꿈을 타협하며 서점 직원으로 일하고 있다. 여섯 번째 이사 끝에 들어온 반지하 방. 좁은 골목마다 빨래가 걸려 있고 손빨래 대야와 양동이가 놓인 그곳에서 나영은 주인할매와 희정엄마, 그리고 옥상에 사는 몽골 청년 솔롱고를 만나게 된다. 바람에 날려 간 빨래 한 장을 계기로 솔롱고와 인사를 나누게 된 나영은, 화려하고 당당해 보이던 희정엄마의 슬픔과 마흔이 넘은 딸을 돌보며 살아가는 주인할매의 숨겨진 사연까지 알게 된다. 그렇게 낯설기만 했던 이웃들은 조금씩 서로의 하루에 스며든다. 그러던 어느 날, 솔롱고는 월급이 밀려 방세를 내지 못하고 나영은 직장에서 부당한 일을 겪게 된다. 힘없이 주저앉은 나영에게 희정엄마와 주인할매는 자신들의 이야기로 위로를 건넨다. 지금을 살아가는 우리 모두의 이야기, 당신의 인생살이에 가장 따뜻한 위로가 되어주는 공연 <빨래>
checklist: 主角【나영】:來首爾第五年,懷著【作家夢】上京,現實逼得她妥協,在【書店】工作
她搬了【六次家】才住進【半地下房(반지하)】
場景細節:巷子裡處處晾著衣服,擺著【手洗衣盆與水桶】
三個鄰居:【주인할매(房東奶奶)】、【희정엄마】、住在【頂樓的蒙古青年 솔롱고】
🚨 솔롱고 是【蒙古人(외국인 노동자)】—— 這是本劇的社會議題核心,不可寫成韓國人
兩人結識的契機是【一件被風吹走的衣服】
주인할매 的隱情=【照顧四十多歲的女兒】;희정엄마 外表華麗自信但內心有悲傷
後段兩件事同時發生:【솔롱고 被積欠薪水而付不出房租】+【나영 在職場遭遇不公】
結尾:희정엄마 與 주인할매【用她們自己的故事安慰나영】—— 是互相慰藉,不是奇蹟解決
戰績:2005 國立劇場首演、超過 20 年、130 萬觀眾、約 7,000 場;2012 日本 replica、2017 中國授權版
26008450.note: 中文劇名【洗衣】(繁簡同名),信心 medium-high(維基與樂迷通行用法,非查得的正式引進定名)。⚠ 本劇有中國授權版,要注意 Perplexity 可能把中文版的改動寫進來。另『빨래』一詞在劇中是雙關(洗衣=把心裡的髒污也洗掉),簡介宜保留這層。
26008450.en:
A gust of wind carries Nayoung's laundry across a rooftop in a modest Seoul hillside neighborhood, bringing her face to face with Solongo, the Mongolian young man living nearby. The two begin with an awkward greeting: Nayoung, who has left Gangwon behind and now works at Jeil Bookstore, is wary of this unfamiliar neighbor, while Solongo approaches her with open warmth. Yet the escaped washing becomes a small bridge between them, and repeated encounters on the rooftops and narrow streets gradually reveal the loneliness beneath their everyday routines.

Nayoung came to Seoul hoping to become a writer, but five difficult years have pushed that dream aside. She works long hours at the bookstore, where the pompous owner Ppang mistreats and harasses employees while demanding their obedience. Solongo has spent five years in Korea working at a factory, trying to sustain himself and his family despite precarious employment and unpaid wages. Around them, the tenants of the neighborhood carry their own burdens, sharing gossip, meals, irritation, and occasional care in the cramped dwellings beneath the sky.

When Ppang unfairly dismisses Nayoung's colleague, Nayoung refuses to stay silent. Her protest turns against her, leaving her transferred, marginalized, and threatened with losing her job. At the same time, Solongo cannot pay his rent because his wages have been delayed, placing his home in jeopardy. One night, an exhausted Nayoung drinks alone; Solongo finds her in an alley and walks her home. When drunken men provoke her, he intervenes and is beaten. Their separate humiliations finally become shared knowledge.

Back on the rooftop, Nayoung and Solongo hang washing together and allow tenderness to replace the guardedness of their first meeting. The clothes fluttering between the buildings become a visible sign that grief, anger, and exhaustion can be aired rather than hidden.

The musical centers on people made vulnerable by insecure work, migration, discrimination, and urban isolation. It finds resilience not in an easy escape from hardship, but in small acts of solidarity, dignity, and love.
26008450.zh:
首爾一條狹窄的半地下街巷裡，從江原道來的娜英整理著新租屋，回想自己離鄉五年、仍在小書店打工的日子。她懷抱寫作夢想，卻得面對老闆的性騷擾、同事遭不當解僱，以及自己被調往倉庫的委屈。某次上頂樓晾衣服時，她遇見住在對面、來自蒙古的移工索隆戈；一陣風把衣物吹過屋頂，兩人便在遞還衣物間逐漸卸下陌生與防備。

索隆戈為了家計遠赴韓國，卻同樣受困於欠薪與房租壓力。巷弄裡還有販售內衣、感情屢受挫折的熙貞媽媽，嘴硬心軟、靠撿紙箱維生的房東奶奶，以及為生活奔走的雜貨店老闆、巴士司機等人；每個人都把說不出口的疲憊，揉進一盆盆衣物裡洗淨、晾曬。

當娜英與索隆戈接連遭逢職場與生計的打擊，兩人一度無力反抗，只能在深夜的酒意與沉默中看見彼此的傷口。鄰居們也以各自不夠完美卻真誠的方式陪伴他們，讓這對異鄉人重新找到面對明天的力量。

一件隨風越過屋頂的衣物，牽起兩個漂泊者，也照見整條街的孤單與溫柔。洗衣不一定洗得去現實的苦澀，卻讓人明白：即使日子艱難，仍能彼此扶持，重新迎向晴朗的天空。
26008450.cn:
首尔一条陡坡小巷的半地下室里，离乡五年、在书店打工的娜英刚搬进新住处，便提着湿衣服走上屋顶。她原想当作家，如今却被房租、工作和拥挤的城市生活磨去了锐气。晾衣时，她遇见住在对面屋顶的蒙古青年索隆戈；这个为梦想和家人生计来到韩国的异乡工人，笨拙而真诚的问候，让娜英一时不知如何回应。

一阵风把娜英的衣物吹到索隆戈那边，他替她拾起、抛回，也让两人渐渐熟悉。巷子里，卖衣服的熙贞妈妈与恋人反复争吵，房东奶奶靠捡纸箱、手洗衣物维持生活；每个人都把难以说出口的忧愁洗进水里，又晾在屋顶的阳光和风中。

书店老板专横轻浮，还因经营混乱迁怒员工。娜英为遭到不公辞退的同事说话，反被调往偏远仓库；索隆戈也被工厂拖欠工资，连房租都难以支付。两个同样被城市挤压的人，在屈辱与无助的夜晚彼此靠近，却发现仅凭愤怒并不能立刻改变现实。

娜英在邻居们的故事和陪伴中重新获得力量，索隆戈也不再独自承受漂泊的寒意。屋顶上随风飘动的衣物，见证着平凡人洗去疲惫、仍决定继续生活的勇气。

26009616.title: 푸른 꽃
26009616.official_plot: 현재시대, 지구에서 가장 먼저 해가 뜨는 섬에 사는 크레타. 단짝 언니 올리브와 최대 관심사인 산호에 대한 이야기를 자주 나눈다. 푸른 산호가 소원을 빌어준다는 전설을 굳게 믿고 있다. 엄마는 소설 <푸른꽃>을 자주 읽어준다. 아빠는 곧 바다에 잠길 섬에 대해 걱정이 많다. 그러던 어느 날, 올리브가 섬을 떠나게 된다. 크레타는 소원을 들어줄 푸른 산호를 더욱 적극적으로 찾으러 나선다. / 중세시대. 청년 하인리히. 상인들과 생애 첫 여행을 떠난다. 상인들은 하인리히에게 시와 자연에 대해 많은 이야기를 해준다. 어느 날 밤, 하인리히는 꿈을 꾼다. 푸른 꽃 속에 여인이 나타나는 꿈이다. 하인리히는 곧 그 여인을 만나 사랑에 빠질 것 같은 기분에 휩싸인다. / 크레타가 읽는 책 <푸른꽃> 속의 주인공이 하인리히이다. 두 세계가 직접 연결되거나 소통하지는 않고 상징과 은유로 결을 같이한다. 하인리히의 이야기는 세상에 내딛는 첫걸음이자 자연을 노래하는 시라면, 크레타의 이야기는 어른들에게 던지는 한 소녀의 간절한 질문이다. — 【크레타 이야기】 현재 시대, 2025년. 남태평양의 작은 미노아 섬. 지구에서 해가 가장 먼저 뜨는 섬에서 살고 있는 소녀 크레타. 단짝 언니 올리브와 최대 관심사인 산호에 대한 이야기를 자주 나눈다. 푸른 산호가 소원을 빌어준다는 전설을 굳게 믿고 있다. 엄마는 소설 <푸른꽃>을 자주 읽어주고, 아빠는 모험가 기질인 딸에 대한 걱정이 많다. 그런데 어느 날, 올리브네 집이 물에 침수되어 올리브가 섬을 떠나게 된다. — 【하인리히 이야기】 중세시대. 1300년대 배경을 둔 소설 <푸른꽃> 이야기. 청년 하인리히는 할아버지 집을 향해 생애 첫 여행을 떠난다. 함께하는 상인들이 하인리히에게 시에 대해 자연에 대해 많은 이야기를 해준다. 여행 중 어느 날 밤에 꿈을 꾸게 된다. 푸른꽃 속에 여인이 나타나는 꿈이다.
checklist: 🚨 這是【雙線平行】的劇:現代線【크레타】+ 中世紀線【하인리히】,官方明說『兩個世界【不直接連結也不互相溝通】,只以象徵與隱喻同調』—— 不可寫成穿越或對話
現代線:【2025 年,南太平洋的小島「미노아(Minoa)섬」】,是地球上【最早日出】的島
크레타 是少女,和死黨姊姊【올리브】最常聊【珊瑚】;她深信【藍珊瑚會實現願望】的傳說
媽媽常唸小說《푸른꽃》給她聽;爸爸擔心的是【這座島即將沉入海裡】(另一處寫『擔心愛冒險的女兒』)
轉折:【올리브 家淹水,올리브 必須離開這座島】→ 크레타 更積極去找那株藍珊瑚
中世紀線:【1300 年代】,青年【하인리히】和商人們踏上【生平第一次旅行】(要去外祖父/爺爺家)
商人們對他講【詩與自然】;某夜他【夢見藍花中出現一位女子】,感到自己即將遇見並愛上她
🚨 兩線的接點是【크레타 讀的那本書《푸른꽃》的主角就是 하인리히】—— 書中書結構
官方定調:하인리히 的故事是『踏向世界的第一步、歌詠自然的詩』;크레타 的故事是『一個少女向大人們拋出的懇切提問』(氣候變遷寓意)
26009616.note: 中文劇名【藍花/蓝花】(取自諾瓦利斯《海因里希·馮·奧夫特丁根》的 blaue Blume 意象,華語定名『藍花』),信心 medium-high。⚠ Perplexity 最可能的錯誤:①把兩條線寫成互相穿越;②直接照諾瓦利斯原著寫(原著是未完成小說,劇裡只取旅行與夢見藍花那一段);③漏掉現代線的【氣候變遷/島嶼沉沒】主題。
26009616.en:
Kreta spends her days on the island where the sun rises first, sharing her fascination with coral with her beloved older friend, Olive. She believes the island’s legend that blue coral can grant a wish, while her mother reads her a book called Blue Flower and her father anxiously watches the sea that will soon swallow their home. When Olive is forced to leave the island, Kreta refuses to accept the separation. Determined to find the miraculous blue coral, she searches more urgently as the adults around her prepare to abandon the place they believe cannot be saved.

Inside the book Kreta reads, a young man named Heinrich travels through a medieval world shaped by merchants, miners, poets, and legends. The people he meets speak to him of poetry and the natural world, opening his imagination to forces larger than himself. One night, Heinrich dreams of a woman appearing within a blue flower. The vision leaves him certain that he is moving toward an encounter that will change his life, and toward a love he has not yet found.

The two narratives echo one another across their distant worlds. Heinrich moves through stories that celebrate the earth and the mysterious connections between people and nature, while Kreta confronts a present in which the sea is rising and the people she loves are preparing to go. As tales, songs, and legends unfold within the wider story, her search for blue coral becomes both a wish to keep Olive close and a desperate appeal to the grown-ups who have decided that surrender is inevitable. Kreta’s voice insists on asking what remains possible when a home, a friendship, and a living world appear to be disappearing.

The musical intertwines longing, love, imagination, and the sustaining force of stories. It contrasts a child’s refusal to give up with an adult world facing environmental loss, asking whether hope can become a form of action.
26009616.zh:
克雷塔住在地球上最早迎來日出的島嶼，日日與最要好的姊姊奧莉芙談論海洋與珊瑚。母親總為她朗讀《藍花》，父親卻憂心海水持續上漲，這座島不久後將被吞沒；當奧莉芙也必須離島，克雷塔更不願接受摯友與故鄉相繼失去的命運。她深信傳說中能實現願望的藍色珊瑚存在，於是踏上尋找它的旅程，盼能留住奧莉芙，也挽回逐漸沉入海中的家園。

另一條時間線裡，中世紀青年海因里希首度隨商隊遠行。旅途中，商人們向他談詩、自然與世界的奧祕，使原本尚未找到方向的他開始渴望以自己的眼睛認識人生。某夜，他夢見一朵藍花，而花間現身的女子令他難以忘懷；醒來後，他相信自己終將與那名女子相遇，便循著夢境的召喚前進。

克雷塔與海因里希未曾真正相會，兩人的道路卻在藍色意象中彼此映照。一個以稚嫩卻堅定的願望追問大人們能否守護自然，一個在啟程與追尋裡學習愛、詩意與自我。當藍花指向的不只是難以尋獲的奇蹟，故事也將希望化為面對失去時仍願意出發的勇氣。
26009616.cn:
2026年，地球上最早迎来日出的海岛正被上涨的海水步步吞没。少女克里特最喜欢和亲如姐姐的奥利芙谈论珊瑚；她深信传说中蓝色珊瑚能够实现愿望，哪怕父亲已在为全岛撤离做准备。可当奥利芙也将离开，克里特不愿接受分别，更不肯相信这座岛只能被放弃，决意去寻找那片能扭转命运的蓝色珊瑚。

与此同时，另一个时代的青年海因里希踏上旅途。商人们向他讲述诗歌、自然与古老传说；夜里，他梦见一朵蓝花和花中出现的女子，仿佛预感到一场尚未发生的相遇与爱情。克里特读着的故事，正将海因里希的道路缓缓展开：旅人、诗人、矿工与传说人物轮番现身，一则则故事彼此嵌套，追问人是否仍能听见自然的声音。

一边是少女为了挽留朋友和故乡而出发，一边是青年循着梦中蓝花寻找心灵的归处。两条跨越时空的旅程在蓝色意象中交汇，让离别、爱与希望获得新的回应。

当大人们认定无路可走，克里特仍以倔强的提问守住对未来的想象。蓝花与蓝色珊瑚最终不只是奇迹的象征，更提醒人们：唯有不遗忘、不放弃，沉睡的希望才可能重新苏醒。

26011611.title: 오셀로와 이아고
26011611.official_plot: 전쟁에서 승리하며 베네치아 최고의 장군이 된 오셀로. 그는 사이프러스 섬의 임시 총독으로 임명된다. 하지만 미천한 출신과 이방인이라는 과거를 딛고 올라온 그의 내면에는 언제든 자신의 자리와 사랑을 빼앗길 수 있다는 불안이 남아 있다. 한편 오셀로를 곁에서 보필하던 이아고는 승전 연회에서 오셀로의 부관 카시오가 술에 취해 사고를 일으키고 파면되자, 마침내 자신에게도 부관이 될 기회가 찾아왔다고 생각한다. 그러나 예상과 달리 사이프러스 사람들은 카시오의 복직을 간청하고, 그를 향한 신뢰와 호의는 오히려 더욱 선명해진다. 그 과정에서 이아고는 오셀로 역시 카시오를 바라보며 자신과 비슷한 불안을 느끼고 있음을 간파한다. 더불어 자신에게 계속해서 선을 긋는 오셀로의 틈을 파고들어, "데스데모나는 정말 당신을 선택한 것인가"라는 의심을 심기 시작한다. 마침 새로운 전쟁이 발발하고, 본국에서는 오셀로를 다시 전쟁에 투입하기 위해 징집 명령을 내린다. 사이프러스를 떠나야 하는 오셀로는 자신이 없는 동안 자신의 자리와 데스데모나의 곁을 누가 차지하게 될지 점점 불안에 사로잡힌다.
checklist: 🚨 形式=【오셀로 與 이아고 兩人的「最後陳述(최후진술)」】,是【搖滾音樂劇】,不是莎劇原樣搬演
🚨【只有兩個角色登台】—— 데스데모나、카시오 都只在【台詞裡被提到】,不出場
🚨【觀眾被指定角色】:元老院議員、審判官,有時是事件的旁觀者
오셀로:戰勝後成為【威尼斯最高將領】,被任命為【賽普勒斯的臨時總督】
他的內在不安來自【出身微賤】與【異邦人】的過去
이아고 的動機(與莎劇不同的寫法):慶功宴上【카시오 醉酒闖禍被免職】,他以為輪到自己當副官
但【賽普勒斯人反而懇求讓카시오復職】,對카시오的信任更明顯 —— 這才是他動念的起點
他看穿【오셀로 對카시오也懷著和自己相似的不安】,於是切入縫隙,種下『데스데모나 真的選擇了你嗎』的疑心
🚨【新的戰爭爆發、本國下徵召令要오셀로重返戰場】—— 這是本改編【新增】的推力,莎劇沒有
官方收在『오셀로 越來越被不安攫住』——【沒有】演到殺妻與自刎
26011611.note: 中文劇名:繁《奧賽羅》(依莎劇通行定名)。⚠ 最大陷阱是【照莎士比亞原劇寫】—— 這個改編動了三處:①只有兩個角色;②伊阿古的動機改成『卡西奧復職』而非單純升遷落空;③新增『新戰爭徵召令』。官方文本也【沒有寫到手帕、殺妻、自刎】。
26011611.en:
Othello stands before judgment as the victorious general’s past collapses into accusation, memory, and the unbearable question of why he killed Desdemona.
